name: Stri Parva

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
hate duryodhane chaiva hate sainye cha sarvashaH |
dhRRitarAShTro mahArAjaH shrutvA kimakaronmune
shlokas.2:
tathaiva kauravo rAjA dharmaputro mahAmanAH |
kRRipaprabhRRitayashchaiva kimakurvata te trayaH
shlokas.3:
ashvatthAmnaH shrutaM karma shApashchAnyonyakAritaH |
vRRittAntamuttaraM brUhi yadabhAShata sa~njayaH
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
hate putrashate dInaM ChinnashAkhamiva drumam |
putrashokAbhisantaptaM dhRRitarAShTraM mahIpatim
shlokas.5:
dhyAnamUkatvamApannaM chintayA samabhiplutam |
abhigamya mahAprAj~naH sa~njayo vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.6:
kiM shochasi mahArAja nAsti shoke sahAyatA |
akShauhiNyo hatAshchAShTau dasha chaiva vishAM pate
nirjaneyaM vasumatI shUnyA samprati kevalA
shlokas.7:
nAnAdigbhyaH samAgamya nAnAdeshyA narAdhipAH |
sahitAstava putreNa sarve vai nidhanaM gatAH
shlokas.8:
pitR^INAM putrapautrANAM j~nAtInAM suhRRidAM tathA |
gurUNAM chAnupUrvyeNa pretakAryANi kAraya
shlokas.9:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tachChrutvA karuNaM vAkyaM putrapautravadhArditaH |
papAta bhuvi durdharSho vAtAhata iva drumaH
shlokas.10:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
hataputro hatAmAtyo hatasarvasuhRRijjanaH |
duHkhaM nUnaM bhaviShyAmi vicharanpRRithivImimAm
shlokas.11:
kiM nu bandhuvihInasya jIvitena mamAdya vai |
lUnapakShasya iva me jarAjIrNasya pakShiNaH
shlokas.12:
hRRitarAjyo hatasuhRRiddhatachakShushcha vai tathA |
na bhrAjiShye mahAprAj~na kShINarashmirivA.nshumAn
shlokas.13:
na kRRitaM suhRRidAM vAkyaM jAmadagnyasya jalpataH |
nAradasya cha devarSheH kRRiShNadvaipAyanasya cha
shlokas.14:
sabhAmadhye tu kRRiShNena yachChreyo.abhihitaM mama |
alaM vaireNa te rAjanputraH sa~NgRRihyatAmiti
shlokas.15:
tachcha vAkyamakRRitvAhaM bhRRishaM tapyAmi durmatiH |
na hi shrotAsmi bhIShmasya dharmayuktaM prabhAShitam
shlokas.16:
duryodhanasya cha tathA vRRiShabhasyeva nardataH |
duHshAsanavadhaM shrutvA karNasya cha viparyayam
droNasUryoparAgaM cha hRRidayaM me vidIryate
shlokas.17:
na smarAmyAtmanaH ki~nchitpurA sa~njaya duShkRRitam |
yasyedaM phalamadyeha mayA mUDhena bhujyate
shlokas.18:
nUnaM hyapakRRitaM ki~nchinmayA pUrveShu janmasu |
yena mAM duHkhabhAgeShu dhAtA karmasu yuktavAn
shlokas.19:
pariNAmashcha vayasaH sarvabandhukShayashcha me |
suhRRinmitravinAshashcha daivayogAdupAgataH
ko.anyo.asti duHkhitataro mayA loke pumAniha
shlokas.20:
tanmAmadyaiva pashyantu pANDavAH sa.nshitavratam |
vivRRitaM brahmalokasya dIrghamadhvAnamAsthitam
shlokas.21:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasya lAlapyamAnasya bahushokaM vichinvataH |
shokApahaM narendrasya sa~njayo vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.22:
shokaM rAjanvyapanuda shrutAste vedanishchayAH |
shAstrAgamAshcha vividhA vRRiddhebhyo nRRipasattama
sRRi~njaye putrashokArte yadUchurmunayaH purA
shlokas.23:
tathA yauvanajaM darpamAsthite te sute nRRipa |
na tvayA suhRRidAM vAkyaM bruvatAmavadhAritam
svArthashcha na kRRitaH kashchillubdhena phalagRRiddhinA
shlokas.24:
tava duHshAsano mantrI rAdheyashcha durAtmavAn |
shakunishchaiva duShTAtmA chitrasenashcha durmatiH
shalyashcha yena vai sarvaM shalyabhUtaM kRRitaM jagat
shlokas.25:
kuruvRRiddhasya bhIShmasya gAndhAryA vidurasya cha |
na kRRitaM vachanaM tena tava putreNa bhArata
shlokas.26:
na dharmaH satkRRitaH kashchinnityaM yuddhamiti bruvan |
kShapitAH kShatriyAH sarve shatrUNAM vardhitaM yashaH
shlokas.27:
madhyastho hi tvamapyAsIrna kShamaM ki~nchiduktavAn |
dhUrdhareNa tvayA bhArastulayA na samaM dhRRitaH
shlokas.28:
AdAveva manuShyeNa vartitavyaM yathA kShamam |
yathA nAtItamarthaM vai pashchAttApena yujyate
shlokas.29:
putragRRiddhyA tvayA rAjanpriyaM tasya chikIrShatA |
pashchAttApamidaM prAptaM na tvaM shochitumarhasi
shlokas.30:
madhu yaH kevalaM dRRiShTvA prapAtaM nAnupashyati |
sa bhraShTo madhulobhena shochatyeva yathA bhavAn
shlokas.31:
arthAnna shochanprApnoti na shochanvindate sukham |
na shocha~nshriyamApnoti na shochanvindate param
shlokas.32:
svayamutpAdayitvAgniM vastreNa pariveShTayet |
dahyamAno manastApaM bhajate na sa paNDitaH
shlokas.33:
tvayaiva sasutenAyaM vAkyavAyusamIritaH |
lobhAjyena cha sa.nsikto jvalitaH pArthapAvakaH
shlokas.34:
tasminsamiddhe patitAH shalabhA iva te sutAH |
tAnkeshavArchirnirdagdhAnna tvaM shochitumarhasi
shlokas.35:
yachchAshrupAtakalilaM vadanaM vahase nRRipa |
ashAstradRRiShTametaddhi na prasha.nsanti paNDitAH
shlokas.36:
visphuli~NgA iva hyetAndahanti kila mAnavAn |
jahIhi manyuM buddhyA vai dhArayAtmAnamAtmanA
shlokas.37:
evamAshvAsitastena sa~njayena mahAtmanA |
viduro bhUya evAha buddhipUrvaM parantapa

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato.amRRitasamairvAkyairhlAdayanpuruSharShabham |
vaichitravIryaM viduro yaduvAcha nibodha tat
shlokas.2:
vidura uvAcha||
uttiShTha rAjankiM sheShe dhArayAtmAnamAtmanA |
sthiraja~NgamamartyAnAM sarveShAmeSha nirNayaH
shlokas.3:
sarve kShayAntA nichayAH patanAntAH samuchChrayAH |
sa.nyogA viprayogAntA maraNAntaM hi jIvitam
shlokas.4:
yadA shUraM cha bhIruM cha yamaH karShati bhArata |
tatkiM na yotsyanti hi te kShatriyAH kShatriyarShabha
shlokas.5:
ayudhyamAno mriyate yudhyamAnashcha jIvati |
kAlaM prApya mahArAja na kashchidativartate
shlokas.6:
na chApyetAnhatAnyuddhe rAja~nshochitumarhasi |
pramANaM yadi shAstrANi gatAste paramAM gatim
shlokas.7:
sarve svAdhyAyavanto hi sarve cha charitavratAH |
sarve chAbhimukhAH kShINAstatra kA paridevanA
shlokas.8:
adarshanAdApatitAH punashchAdarshanaM gatAH |
na te tava na teShAM tvaM tatra kA paridevanA
shlokas.9:
hato.api labhate svargaM hatvA cha labhate yashaH |
ubhayaM no bahuguNaM nAsti niShphalatA raNe
shlokas.10:
teShAM kAmadughA.NllokAnindraH sa~NkalpayiShyati |
indrasyAtithayo hyete bhavanti puruSharShabha
shlokas.11:
na yaj~nairdakShiNAvadbhirna tapobhirna vidyayA |
svargaM yAnti tathA martyA yathA shUrA raNe hatAH
shlokas.12:
mAtApitRRisahasrANi putradArashatAni cha |
sa.nsAreShvanubhUtAni kasya te kasya vA vayam
shlokas.13:
shokasthAnasahasrANi bhayasthAnashatAni cha |
divase divase mUDhamAvishanti na paNDitam
shlokas.14:
na kAlasya priyaH kashchinna dveShyaH kurusattama |
na madhyasthaH kvachitkAlaH sarvaM kAlaH prakarShati
shlokas.15:
anityaM jIvitaM rUpaM yauvanaM dravyasa~nchayaH |
ArogyaM priyasa.nvAso gRRidhyedeShu na paNDitaH
shlokas.16:
na jAnapadikaM duHkhamekaH shochitumarhasi |
apyabhAvena yujyeta tachchAsya na nivartate
shlokas.17:
ashochanpratikurvIta yadi pashyetparAkramam |
bhaiShajyametadduHkhasya yadetannAnuchintayet
chintyamAnaM hi na vyeti bhUyashchApi vivardhate
shlokas.18:
aniShTasamprayogAchcha viprayogAtpriyasya cha |
manuShyA mAnasairduHkhairyujyante ye.alpabuddhayaH
shlokas.19:
nArtho na dharmo na sukhaM yadetadanushochasi |
na cha nApaiti kAryArthAttrivargAchchaiva bhrashyate
shlokas.20:
anyAmanyAM dhanAvasthAM prApya vaisheShikIM narAH |
asantuShTAH pramuhyanti santoShaM yAnti paNDitAH
shlokas.21:
praj~nayA mAnasaM duHkhaM hanyAchChArIramauShadhaiH |
etajj~nAnasya sAmarthyaM na bAlaiH samatAmiyAt
shlokas.22:
shayAnaM chAnushayati tiShThantaM chAnutiShThati |
anudhAvati dhAvantaM karma pUrvakRRitaM naram
shlokas.23:
yasyAM yasyAmavasthAyAM yatkaroti shubhAshubham |
tasyAM tasyAmavasthAyAM tattatphalamupAshnute

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
subhAShitairmahAprAj~na shoko.ayaM vigato mama |
bhuya eva tu vAkyAni shrotumichChAmi tattvataH
shlokas.2:
aniShTAnAM cha sa.nsargAdiShTAnAM cha vivarjanAt |
kathaM hi mAnasairduHkhaiH pramuchyante.atra paNDitAH
shlokas.3:
vidura uvAcha||
yato yato mano duHkhAtsukhAdvApi pramuchyate |
tatastataH shamaM labdhvA sugatiM vindate budhaH
shlokas.4:
ashAshvatamidaM sarvaM chintyamAnaM nararShabha |
kadalIsaMnibho lokaH sAro hyasya na vidyate
shlokas.5:
gRRihANyeva hi martyAnAmAhurdehAni paNDitAH |
kAlena viniyujyante sattvamekaM tu shobhanam
shlokas.6:
yathA jIrNamajIrNaM vA vastraM tyaktvA tu vai naraH |
anyadrochayate vastramevaM dehAH sharIriNAm
shlokas.7:
vaichitravIrya vAsaM hi duHkhaM vA yadi vA sukham |
prApnuvantIha bhUtAni svakRRitenaiva karmaNA
shlokas.8:
karmaNA prApyate svargaM sukhaM duHkhaM cha bhArata |
tato vahati taM bhAramavashaH svavasho.api vA
shlokas.9:
yathA cha mRRinmayaM bhANDaM chakrArUDhaM vipadyate |
ki~nchitprakriyamANaM vA kRRitamAtramathApi vA
shlokas.10:
ChinnaM vApyavaropyantamavatIrNamathApi vA |
ArdraM vApyatha vA shuShkaM pachyamAnamathApi vA
shlokas.11:
avatAryamANamApAkAduddhRRitaM vApi bhArata |
atha vA paribhujyantamevaM dehAH sharIriNAm
shlokas.12:
garbhastho vA prasUto vApyatha vA divasAntaraH |
ardhamAsagato vApi mAsamAtragato.api vA
shlokas.13:
sa.nvatsaragato vApi dvisa.nvatsara eva vA |
yauvanastho.api madhyastho vRRiddho vApi vipadyate
shlokas.14:
prAkkarmabhistu bhUtAni bhavanti na bhavanti cha |
evaM sA.nsiddhike loke kimarthamanutapyase
shlokas.15:
yathA cha salile rAjankrIDArthamanusa~ncharan |
unmajjechcha nimajjechcha ki~nchitsattvaM narAdhipa
shlokas.16:
evaM sa.nsAragahanAdunmajjananimajjanAt |
karmabhogena badhyantaH klishyante ye.alpabuddhayaH
shlokas.17:
ye tu prAj~nAH sthitAH satye sa.nsArAntagaveShiNaH |
samAgamaj~nA bhUtAnAM te yAnti paramAM gatim

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
kathaM sa.nsAragahanaM vij~neyaM vadatAM vara |
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM tattvamAkhyAhi pRRichChataH
shlokas.2:
vidura uvAcha||
janmaprabhRRiti bhUtAnAM kriyAH sarvAH shRRiNu prabho |
pUrvameveha kalale vasate ki~nchidantaram
shlokas.3:
tataH sa pa~nchame.atIte mAse mA.nsaM prakalpayet |
tataH sarvA~NgasampUrNo garbho mAse prajAyate
shlokas.4:
amedhyamadhye vasati mA.nsashoNitalepane |
tatastu vAyuvegena UrdhvapAdo hyadhaHshirAH
shlokas.5:
yonidvAramupAgamya bahUnkleshAnsamRRichChati |
yonisampIDanAchchaiva pUrvakarmabhiranvitaH
shlokas.6:
tasmAnmuktaH sa sa.nsArAdanyAnpashyatyupadravAn |
grahAstamupasarpanti sArameyA ivAmiSham
shlokas.7:
tataH prAptottare kAle vyAdhayashchApi taM tathA |
upasarpanti jIvantaM badhyamAnaM svakarmabhiH
shlokas.8:
baddhamindriyapAshaistaM sa~NgasvAdubhirAturam |
vyasanAnyupavartante vividhAni narAdhipa
badhyamAnashcha tairbhUyo naiva tRRiptimupaiti saH
shlokas.9:
ayaM na budhyate tAvadyamalokamathAgatam |
yamadUtairvikRRiShya.nshcha mRRityuM kAlena gachChati
shlokas.10:
vAgghInasya cha yanmAtramiShTAniShTaM kRRitaM mukhe |
bhUya evAtmanAtmAnaM badhyamAnamupekShate
shlokas.11:
aho vinikRRito loko lobhena cha vashIkRRitaH |
lobhakrodhamadonmatto nAtmAnamavabudhyate
shlokas.12:
kulInatvena ramate duShkulInAnvikutsayan |
dhanadarpeNa dRRiptashcha daridrAnparikutsayan
shlokas.13:
mUrkhAniti parAnAha nAtmAnaM samavekShate |
shikShAM kShipati chAnyeShAM nAtmAnaM shAstumichChati
shlokas.14:
adhruve jIvaloke.asminyo dharmamanupAlayan |
janmaprabhRRiti varteta prApnuyAtparamAM gatim
shlokas.15:
evaM sarvaM viditvA vai yastattvamanuvartate |
sa pramokShAya labhate panthAnaM manujAdhipa

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yadidaM dharmagahanaM buddhyA samanugamyate |
etadvistarashaH sarvaM buddhimArgaM prasha.nsa me
shlokas.2:
vidura uvAcha||
atra te vartayiShyAmi namaskRRitvA svayambhuve |
yathA sa.nsAragahanaM vadanti paramarShayaH
shlokas.3:
kashchinmahati sa.nsAre vartamAno dvijaH kila |
vanaM durgamanuprApto mahatkravyAdasa~Nkulam
shlokas.4:
siMhavyAghragajAkArairatighorairmahAshanaiH |
samantAtsamparikShiptaM mRRityorapi bhayapradam
shlokas.5:
tadasya dRRiShTvA hRRidayamudvegamagamatparam |
abhyuchChrayashcha romNAM vai vikriyAshcha parantapa
shlokas.6:
sa tadvanaM vyanusaranvipradhAvanitastataH |
vIkShamANo dishaH sarvAH sharaNaM kva bhavediti
shlokas.7:
sa teShAM ChidramanvichChanpradruto bhayapIDitaH |
na cha niryAti vai dUraM na cha tairviprayujyate
shlokas.8:
athApashyadvanaM ghoraM samantAdvAgurAvRRitam |
bAhubhyAM sampariShvaktaM striyA paramaghorayA
shlokas.9:
pa~nchashIrShadharairnAgaiH shailairiva samunnataiH |
nabhaHspRRishairmahAvRRikShaiH parikShiptaM mahAvanam
shlokas.10:
vanamadhye cha tatrAbhUdudapAnaH samAvRRitaH |
vallIbhistRRiNaChannAbhirgUDhAbhirabhisa.nvRRitaH
shlokas.11:
papAta sa dvijastatra nigUDhe salilAshaye |
vilagnashchAbhavattasmi.NllatAsantAnasa~NkaTe
shlokas.12:
panasasya yathA jAtaM vRRintabaddhaM mahAphalam |
sa tathA lambate tatra UrdhvapAdo hyadhaHshirAH
shlokas.13:
atha tatrApi chAnyo.asya bhUyo jAta upadravaH |
kUpavInAhavelAyAmapashyata mahAgajam
shlokas.14:
ShaDvaktraM kRRiShNashabalaM dviShaTkapadachAriNam |
krameNa parisarpantaM vallIvRRikShasamAvRRitam
shlokas.15:
tasya chApi prashAkhAsu vRRikShashAkhAvalambinaH |
nAnArUpA madhukarA ghorarUpA bhayAvahAH
Asate madhu sambhRRitya pUrvameva niketajAH
shlokas.16:
bhUyo bhUyaH samIhante madhUni bharatarShabha |
svAdanIyAni bhUtAnAM na yairbAlo.api tRRipyate
shlokas.17:
teShAM madhUnAM bahudhA dhArA prasravate sadA |
tAM lambamAnaH sa pumAndhArAM pibati sarvadA
na chAsya tRRiShNA viratA pibamAnasya sa~NkaTe
shlokas.18:
abhIpsati cha tAM nityamatRRiptaH sa punaH punaH |
na chAsya jIvite rAjannirvedaH samajAyata
shlokas.19:
tatraiva cha manuShyasya jIvitAshA pratiShThitA |
kRRiShNAH shvetAshcha taM vRRikShaM kuTTayanti sma mUShakAH
shlokas.20:
vyAlaishcha vanadurgAnte striyA cha paramograyA |
kUpAdhastAchcha nAgena vInAhe ku~njareNa cha
shlokas.21:
vRRikShaprapAtAchcha bhayaM mUShakebhyashcha pa~nchamam |
madhulobhAnmadhukaraiH ShaShThamAhurmahadbhayam
shlokas.22:
evaM sa vasate tatra kShiptaH sa.nsArasAgare |
na chaiva jIvitAshAyAM nirvedamupagachChati

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
aho khalu mahadduHkhaM kRRichChravAsaM vasatyasau |
kathaM tasya ratistatra tuShTirvA vadatAM vara
shlokas.2:
sa deshaH kva nu yatrAsau vasate dharmasa~NkaTe |
kathaM vA sa vimuchyeta narastasmAnmahAbhayAt
shlokas.3:
etanme sarvamAchakShva sAdhu cheShTAmahe tathA |
kRRipA me mahatI jAtA tasyAbhyuddharaNena hi
shlokas.4:
vidura uvAcha||
upamAnamidaM rAjanmokShavidbhirudAhRRitam |
sugatiM vindate yena paralokeShu mAnavaH
shlokas.5:
yattaduchyati kAntAraM mahatsa.nsAra eva saH |
vanaM durgaM hi yattvetatsa.nsAragahanaM hi tat
shlokas.6:
ye cha te kathitA vyAlA vyAdhayaste prakIrtitAH |
yA sA nArI bRRihatkAyA adhitiShThati tatra vai
tAmAhustu jarAM prAj~nA varNarUpavinAshinIm
shlokas.7:
yastatra kUpo nRRipate sa tu dehaH sharIriNAm |
yastatra vasate.adhastAnmahAhiH kAla eva saH
antakaH sarvabhUtAnAM dehinAM sarvahAryasau
shlokas.8:
kUpamadhye cha yA jAtA vallI yatra sa mAnavaH |
pratAne lambate sA tu jIvitAshA sharIriNAm
shlokas.9:
sa yastu kUpavInAhe taM vRRikShaM parisarpati |
ShaDvaktraH ku~njaro rAjansa tu sa.nvatsaraH smRRitaH
mukhAni RRitavo mAsAH pAdA dvAdasha kIrtitAH
shlokas.10:
ye tu vRRikShaM nikRRintanti mUShakAH satatotthitAH |
rAtryahAni tu tAnyAhurbhUtAnAM parichintakAH
ye te madhukarAstatra kAmAste parikIrtitAH
shlokas.11:
yAstu tA bahusho dhArAH sravanti madhunisravam |
tA.nstu kAmarasAnvidyAdyatra majjanti mAnavAH
shlokas.12:
evaM sa.nsArachakrasya parivRRittiM sma ye viduH |
te vai sa.nsArachakrasya pAshA.nshChindanti vai budhAH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
aho.abhihitamAkhyAnaM bhavatA tattvadarshinA |
bhUya eva tu me harShaH shrotuM vAgamRRitaM tava
shlokas.2:
vidura uvAcha||
shRRiNu bhUyaH pravakShyAmi mArgasyaitasya vistaram |
yachChrutvA vipramuchyante sa.nsArebhyo vichakShaNAH
shlokas.3:
yathA tu puruSho rAjandIrghamadhvAnamAsthitaH |
kvachitkvachichChramAtsthAtA kurute vAsameva vA
shlokas.4:
evaM sa.nsAraparyAye garbhavAseShu bhArata |
kurvanti durbudhA vAsaM muchyante tatra paNDitAH
shlokas.5:
tasmAdadhvAnamevaitamAhuH shAstravido janAH |
yattu sa.nsAragahanaM vanamAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.6:
so.ayaM lokasamAvarto martyAnAM bharatarShabha |
charANAM sthAvarANAM cha gRRidhyettatra na paNDitaH
shlokas.7:
shArIrA mAnasAshchaiva martyAnAM ye tu vyAdhayaH |
pratyakShAshcha parokShAshcha te vyAlAH kathitA budhaiH
shlokas.8:
klishyamAnAshcha tairnityaM hanyamAnAshcha bhArata |
svakarmabhirmahAvyAlairnodvijantyalpabuddhayaH
shlokas.9:
athApi tairvimuchyeta vyAdhibhiH puruSho nRRipa |
AvRRiNotyeva taM pashchAjjarA rUpavinAshinI
shlokas.10:
shabdarUparasasparshairgandhaishcha vividhairapi |
majjamAnaM mahApa~Nke nirAlambe samantataH
shlokas.11:
sa.nvatsarartavo mAsAH pakShAhorAtrasandhayaH |
krameNAsya pralumpanti rUpamAyustathaiva cha
shlokas.12:
ete kAlasya nidhayo naitA~njAnanti durbudhAH |
atrAbhilikhitAnyAhuH sarvabhUtAni karmaNA
shlokas.13:
rathaM sharIraM bhUtAnAM sattvamAhustu sArathim |
indriyANi hayAnAhuH karma buddhishcha rashmayaH
shlokas.14:
teShAM hayAnAM yo vegaM dhAvatAmanudhAvati |
sa tu sa.nsArachakre.asmi.nshchakravatparivartate
shlokas.15:
yastAnyamayate buddhyA sa yantA na nivartate |
yAmyamAhU rathaM hyenaM muhyante yena durbudhAH
shlokas.16:
sa chaitatprApnute rAjanyattvaM prApto narAdhipa |
rAjyanAshaM suhRRinnAshaM sutanAshaM cha bhArata
shlokas.17:
anutarShulamevaitadduHkhaM bhavati bhArata |
sAdhuH paramaduHkhAnAM duHkhabhaiShajyamAcharet
shlokas.18:
na vikramo na chApyartho na mitraM na suhRRijjanaH |
tathonmochayate duHkhAdyathAtmA sthirasa.nyamaH
shlokas.19:
tasmAnmaitraM samAsthAya shIlamApadya bhArata |
damastyAgo.apramAdashcha te trayo brahmaNo hayAH
shlokas.20:
shIlarashmisamAyukte sthito yo mAnase rathe |
tyaktvA mRRityubhayaM rAjanbrahmalokaM sa gachChati

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vidurasya tu tadvAkyaM nishamya kurusattamaH |
putrashokAbhisantaptaH papAta bhuvi mUrChitaH
shlokas.2:
taM tathA patitaM bhUmau niHsa~nj~naM prekShya bAndhavAH |
kRRiShNadvaipAyanashchaiva kShattA cha vidurastathA
shlokas.3:
sa~njayaH suhRRidashchAnye dvAHsthA ye chAsya saMmatAH |
jalena sukhashItena tAlavRRintaishcha bhArata
shlokas.4:
paspRRishushcha karairgAtraM vIjamAnAshcha yatnataH |
anvAsansuchiraM kAlaM dhRRitarAShTraM tathAgatam
shlokas.5:
atha dIrghasya kAlasya labdhasa~nj~no mahIpatiH |
vilalApa chiraM kAlaM putrAdhibhirabhiplutaH
shlokas.6:
dhigastu khalu mAnuShyaM mAnuShye cha parigraham |
yatomUlAni duHkhAni sambhavanti muhurmuhuH
shlokas.7:
putranAshe.arthanAshe cha j~nAtisambandhinAmapi |
prApyate sumahadduHkhaM viShAgnipratimaM vibho
shlokas.8:
yena dahyanti gAtrANi yena praj~nA vinashyati |
yenAbhibhUtaH puruSho maraNaM bahu manyate
shlokas.9:
tadidaM vyasanaM prAptaM mayA bhAgyaviparyayAt |
tachchaivAhaM kariShyAmi adyaiva dvijasattama
shlokas.10:
ityuktvA tu mahAtmAnaM pitaraM brahmavittamam |
dhRRitarAShTro.abhavanmUDhaH shokaM cha paramaM gataH
abhUchcha tUShNIM rAjAsau dhyAyamAno mahIpate
shlokas.11:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA kRRiShNadvaipAyanaH prabhuH |
putrashokAbhisantaptaM putraM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.12:
dhRRitarAShTra mahAbAho yattvAM vakShyAmi tachChRRiNu |
shrutavAnasi medhAvI dharmArthakushalastathA
shlokas.13:
na te.astyaviditaM ki~nchidveditavyaM parantapa |
anityatAM hi martyAnAM vijAnAsi na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.14:
adhruve jIvaloke cha sthAne vAshAshvate sati |
jIvite maraNAnte cha kasmAchChochasi bhArata
shlokas.15:
pratyakShaM tava rAjendra vairasyAsya samudbhavaH |
putraM te kAraNaM kRRitvA kAlayogena kAritaH
shlokas.16:
avashyaM bhavitavye cha kurUNAM vaishase nRRipa |
kasmAchChochasi tA~nshUrAngatAnparamikAM gatim
shlokas.17:
jAnatA cha mahAbAho vidureNa mahAtmanA |
yatitaM sarvayatnena shamaM prati janeshvara
shlokas.18:
na cha daivakRRito mArgaH shakyo bhUtena kenachit |
ghaTatApi chiraM kAlaM niyantumiti me matiH
shlokas.19:
devatAnAM hi yatkAryaM mayA pratyakShataH shrutam |
tatte.ahaM sampravakShyAmi kathaM sthairyaM bhavettava
shlokas.20:
purAhaM tvarito yAtaH sabhAmaindrIM jitaklamaH |
apashyaM tatra cha tadA samavetAndivaukasaH
nAradapramukhA.nshchApi sarvAndevaRRiShI.nstathA
shlokas.21:
tatra chApi mayA dRRiShTA pRRithivI pRRithivIpate |
kAryArthamupasamprAptA devatAnAM samIpataH
shlokas.22:
upagamya tadA dhAtrI devAnAha samAgatAn |
yatkAryaM mama yuShmAbhirbrahmaNaH sadane tadA
pratij~nAtaM mahAbhAgAstachChIghraM sa.nvidhIyatAm
shlokas.23:
tasyAstadvachanaM shrutvA viShNurlokanamaskRRitaH |
uvAcha prahasanvAkyaM pRRithivIM devasa.nsadi
shlokas.24:
dhRRitarAShTrasya putrANAM yastu jyeShThaH shatasya vai |
duryodhana iti khyAtaH sa te kAryaM kariShyati
taM cha prApya mahIpAlaM kRRitakRRityA bhaviShyasi
shlokas.25:
tasyArthe pRRithivIpAlAH kurukShetre samAgatAH |
anyonyaM ghAtayiShyanti dRRiDhaiH shastraiH prahAriNaH
shlokas.26:
tataste bhavitA devi bhArasya yudhi nAshanam |
gachCha shIghraM svakaM sthAnaM lokAndhAraya shobhane
shlokas.27:
sa eSha te suto rAja.NllokasaMhArakAraNAt |
kalera.nshaH samutpanno gAndhAryA jaThare nRRipa
shlokas.28:
amarShI chapalashchApi krodhano duShprasAdhanaH |
daivayogAtsamutpannA bhrAtarashchAsya tAdRRishAH
shlokas.29:
shakunirmAtulashchaiva karNashcha paramaH sakhA |
samutpannA vinAshArthaM pRRithivyAM sahitA nRRipAH
etamarthaM mahAbAho nArado veda tattvataH
shlokas.30:
AtmAparAdhAtputrAste vinaShTAH pRRithivIpate |
mA tA~nshochasva rAjendra na hi shoke.asti kAraNam
shlokas.31:
na hi te pANDavAH svalpamaparAdhyanti bhArata |
putrAstava durAtmAno yairiyaM ghAtitA mahI
shlokas.32:
nAradena cha bhadraM te pUrvameva na sa.nshayaH |
yudhiShThirasya samitau rAjasUye niveditam
shlokas.33:
pANDavAH kauravAshchaiva samAsAdya parasparam |
na bhaviShyanti kaunteya yatte kRRityaM tadAchara
shlokas.34:
nAradasya vachaH shrutvA tadAshochanta pANDavAH |
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM devaguhyaM sanAtanam
shlokas.35:
kathaM te shokanAshaH syAtprANeShu cha dayA prabho |
snehashcha pANDuputreShu j~nAtvA daivakRRitaM vidhim
shlokas.36:
eSha chArtho mahAbAho pUrvameva mayA shrutaH |
kathito dharmarAjasya rAjasUye kratUttame
shlokas.37:
yatitaM dharmaputreNa mayA guhye nivedite |
avigrahe kauravANAM daivaM tu balavattaram
shlokas.38:
anatikramaNIyo hi vidhI rAjankatha~nchana |
kRRitAntasya hi bhUtena sthAvareNa trasena cha
shlokas.39:
bhavAnkarmaparo yatra buddhishreShThashcha bhArata |
muhyate prANinAM j~nAtvA gatiM chAgatimeva cha
shlokas.40:
tvAM tu shokena santaptaM muhyamAnaM muhurmuhuH |
j~nAtvA yudhiShThiro rAjA prANAnapi parityajet
shlokas.41:
kRRipAlurnityasho vIrastiryagyonigateShvapi |
sa kathaM tvayi rAjendra kRRipAM vai na kariShyati
shlokas.42:
mama chaiva niyogena vidheshchApyanivartanAt |
pANDavAnAM cha kAruNyAtprANAndhAraya bhArata
shlokas.43:
evaM te vartamAnasya loke kIrtirbhaviShyati |
dharmashcha sumahA.nstAta taptaM syAchcha tapashchirAt
shlokas.44:
putrashokasamutpannaM hutAshaM jvalitaM yathA |
praj~nAmbhasA mahArAja nirvApaya sadA sadA
shlokas.45:
etachChrutvA tu vachanaM vyAsasyAmitatejasaH |
muhUrtaM samanudhyAya dhRRitarAShTro.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.46:
mahatA shokajAlena praNunno.asmi dvijottama |
nAtmAnamavabudhyAmi muhyamAno muhurmuhuH
shlokas.47:
idaM tu vachanaM shrutvA tava daivaniyogajam |
dhArayiShyAmyahaM prANAnyatiShye cha nashochitum
shlokas.48:
etachChrutvA tu vachanaM vyAsaH satyavatIsutaH |
dhRRitarAShTrasya rAjendra tatraivAntaradhIyata

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
gate bhagavati vyAse dhRRitarAShTro mahIpatiH |
kimacheShTata viprarShe tanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA narashreShTha chiraM dhyAtvA tvachetanaH |
sa~njayaM yojayetyuktvA viduraM pratyabhAShata
shlokas.3:
kShipramAnaya gAndhArIM sarvAshcha bharatastriyaH |
vadhUM kuntImupAdAya yAshchAnyAstatra yoShitaH
shlokas.4:
evamuktvA sa dharmAtmA viduraM dharmavittamam |
shokaviprahataj~nAno yAnamevAnvapadyata
shlokas.5:
gAndhArI chaiva shokArtA bharturvachanachoditA |
saha kuntyA yato rAjA saha strIbhirupAdravat
shlokas.6:
tAH samAsAdya rAjAnaM bhRRishaM shokasamanvitAH |
AmantryAnyonyamIyuH sma bhRRishamuchchukrushustataH
shlokas.7:
tAH samAshvAsayatkShattA tAbhyashchArtataraH svayam |
ashrukaNThIH samAropya tato.asau niryayau purAt
shlokas.8:
tataH praNAdaH sa~njaj~ne sarveShu kuruveshmasu |
AkumAraM puraM sarvamabhavachChokakarshitam
shlokas.9:
adRRiShTapUrvA yA nAryaH purA devagaNairapi |
pRRithagjanena dRRishyanta tAstadA nihateshvarAH
shlokas.10:
prakIrya keshAnsushubhAnbhUShaNAnyavamuchya cha |
ekavastradharA nAryaH paripeturanAthavat
shlokas.11:
shvetaparvatarUpebhyo gRRihebhyastAstvapAkraman |
guhAbhya iva shailAnAM pRRiShatyo hatayUthapAH
shlokas.12:
tAnyudIrNAni nArINAM tadA vRRindAnyanekashaH |
shokArtAnyadravanrAjankishorINAmivA~Ngane
shlokas.13:
pragRRihya bAhUnkroshantyaH putrAnbhrAtR^InpitR^Inapi |
darshayantIva tA ha sma yugAnte lokasa~NkShayam
shlokas.14:
vilapantyo rudantyashcha dhAvamAnAstatastataH |
shokenAbhyAhataj~nAnAH kartavyaM na prajaj~nire
shlokas.15:
vrIDAM jagmuH purA yAH sma sakhInAmapi yoShitaH |
tA ekavastrA nirlajjAH shvashrUNAM purato.abhavan
shlokas.16:
parasparaM susUkShmeShu shokeShvAshvAsayansma yAH |
tAH shokavihvalA rAjannupaikShanta parasparam
shlokas.17:
tAbhiH parivRRito rAjA rudatIbhiH sahasrashaH |
niryayau nagarAddInastUrNamAyodhanaM prati
shlokas.18:
shilpino vaNijo vaishyAH sarvakarmopajIvinaH |
te pArthivaM puraskRRitya niryayurnagarAdbahiH
shlokas.19:
tAsAM vikroshamAnAnAmArtAnAM kurusa~NkShaye |
prAdurAsInmahA~nshabdo vyathayanbhuvanAnyuta
shlokas.20:
yugAntakAle samprApte bhUtAnAM dahyatAmiva |
abhAvaH syAdayaM prApta iti bhUtAni menire
shlokas.21:
bhRRishamudvignamanasaste paurAH kurusa~NkShaye |
prAkroshanta mahArAja svanuraktAstadA bhRRisham

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kroshamAtraM tato gatvA dadRRishustAnmahArathAn |
shAradvataM kRRipaM drauNiM kRRitavarmANameva cha
shlokas.2:
te tu dRRiShTvaiva rAjAnaM praj~nAchakShuShamIshvaram |
ashrukaNThA viniHshvasya rudantamidamabruvan
shlokas.3:
putrastava mahArAja kRRitvA karma suduShkaram |
gataH sAnucharo rAja~nshakralokaM mahIpatiH
shlokas.4:
duryodhanabalAnmuktA vayameva trayo rathAH |
sarvamanyatparikShINaM sainyaM te bharatarShabha
shlokas.5:
ityevamuktvA rAjAnaM kRRipaH shAradvatastadA |
gAndhArIM putrashokArtAmidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.6:
abhItA yudhyamAnAste ghnantaH shatrugaNAnbahUn |
vIrakarmANi kurvANAH putrAste nidhanaM gatAH
shlokas.7:
dhruvaM samprApya lokA.nste nirmalA~nshastranirjitAn |
bhAsvaraM dehamAsthAya viharantyamarA iva
shlokas.8:
na hi kashchiddhi shUrANAM yudhyamAnaH parA~NmukhaH |
shastreNa nidhanaM prApto na cha kashchitkRRitA~njaliH
shlokas.9:
etAM tAM kShatriyasyAhuH purANAM paramAM gatim |
shastreNa nidhanaM sa~Nkhye tAnna shochitumarhasi
shlokas.10:
na chApi shatravasteShAmRRidhyante rAj~ni pANDavAH |
shRRiNu yatkRRitamasmAbhirashvatthAmapurogamaiH
shlokas.11:
adharmeNa hataM shrutvA bhImasenena te sutam |
suptaM shibiramAvishya pANDUnAM kadanaM kRRitam
shlokas.12:
pA~nchAlA nihatAH sarve dhRRiShTadyumnapurogamAH |
drupadasyAtmajAshchaiva draupadeyAshcha pAtitAH
shlokas.13:
tathA vishasanaM kRRitvA putrashatrugaNasya te |
prAdravAma raNe sthAtuM na hi shakyAmahe trayaH
shlokas.14:
te hi shUrA maheShvAsAH kShiprameShyanti pANDavAH |
amarShavashamApannA vairaM pratijihIrShavaH
shlokas.15:
nihatAnAtmajA~nshrutvA pramattAnpuruSharShabhAH |
ninIShantaH padaM shUrAH kShiprameva yashasvini
shlokas.16:
pANDUnAM kilbiShaM kRRitvA sa.nsthAtuM notsahAmahe |
anujAnIhi no rAj~ni mA cha shoke manaH kRRithAH
shlokas.17:
rAja.nstvamanujAnIhi dhairyamAtiShTha chottamam |
niShThAntaM pashya chApi tvaM kShatradharmaM cha kevalam
shlokas.18:
ityevamuktvA rAjAnaM kRRitvA chAbhipradakShiNam |
kRRipashcha kRRitavarmA cha droNaputrashcha bhArata
shlokas.19:
avekShamANA rAjAnaM dhRRitarAShTraM manIShiNam |
ga~NgAmanu mahAtmAnastUrNamashvAnachodayan
shlokas.20:
apakramya tu te rAjansarva eva mahArathAH |
AmantryAnyonyamudvignAstridhA te prayayustataH
shlokas.21:
jagAma hAstinapuraM kRRipaH shAradvatastadA |
svameva rAShTraM hArdikyo drauNirvyAsAshramaM yayau
shlokas.22:
evaM te prayayurvIrA vIkShamANAH parasparam |
bhayArtAH pANDuputrANAmAgaskRRitvA mahAtmanAm
shlokas.23:
sametya vIrA rAjAnaM tadA tvanudite ravau |
viprajagmurmahArAja yathechChakamari.ndamAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
hateShu sarvasainyeShu dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
shushruve pitaraM vRRiddhaM niryAtaM gajasAhvayAt
shlokas.2:
so.abhyayAtputrashokArtaH putrashokapariplutam |
shochamAno mahArAja bhrAtRRibhiH sahitastadA
shlokas.3:
anvIyamAno vIreNa dAshArheNa mahAtmanA |
yuyudhAnena cha tathA tathaiva cha yuyutsunA
shlokas.4:
tamanvagAtsuduHkhArtA draupadI shokakarshitA |
saha pA~nchAlayoShidbhiryAstatrAsansamAgatAH
shlokas.5:
sa ga~NgAmanu vRRindAni strINAM bharatasattama |
kurarINAmivArtAnAM kroshantInAM dadarsha ha
shlokas.6:
tAbhiH parivRRito rAjA rudatIbhiH sahasrashaH |
UrdhvabAhubhirArtAbhirbruvatIbhiH priyApriye
shlokas.7:
kva nu dharmaj~natA rAj~naH kva nu sAdyAnRRisha.nsatA |
yadAvadhItpitR^InbhrAtR^IngurUnputrAnsakhInapi
shlokas.8:
ghAtayitvA kathaM droNaM bhIShmaM chApi pitAmaham |
manaste.abhUnmahAbAho hatvA chApi jayadratham
shlokas.9:
kiM nu rAjyena te kAryaM pitR^InbhrAtR^InapashyataH |
abhimanyuM cha durdharShaM draupadeyA.nshcha bhArata
shlokas.10:
atItya tA mahAbAhuH kroshantIH kurarIriva |
vavande pitaraM jyeShThaM dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.11:
tato.abhivAdya pitaraM dharmeNAmitrakarshanAH |
nyavedayanta nAmAni pANDavAste.api sarvashaH
shlokas.12:
tamAtmajAntakaraNaM pitA putravadhArditaH |
aprIyamANaH shokArtaH pANDavaM pariShasvaje
shlokas.13:
dharmarAjaM pariShvajya sAntvayitvA cha bhArata |
duShTAtmA bhImamanvaichChaddidhakShuriva pAvakaH
shlokas.14:
sa kopapAvakastasya shokavAyusamIritaH |
bhImasenamayaM dAvaM didhakShuriva dRRishyate
shlokas.15:
tasya sa~NkalpamAj~nAya bhImaM pratyashubhaM hariH |
bhImamAkShipya pANibhyAM pradadau bhImamAyasam
shlokas.16:
prAgeva tu mahAbuddhirbuddhvA tasye~NgitaM hariH |
sa.nvidhAnaM mahAprAj~nastatra chakre janArdanaH
shlokas.17:
taM tu gRRihyaiva pANibhyAM bhImasenamayasmayam |
babha~nja balavAnrAjA manyamAno vRRikodaram
shlokas.18:
nAgAyutabalaprANaH sa rAjA bhImamAyasam |
bha~NktvA vimathitoraskaH susrAva rudhiraM mukhAt
shlokas.19:
tataH papAta medinyAM tathaiva rudhirokShitaH |
prapuShpitAgrashikharaH pArijAta iva drumaH
shlokas.20:
paryagRRihNata taM vidvAnsUto gAvalgaNistadA |
maivamityabravIchchainaM shamayansAntvayanniva
shlokas.21:
sa tu kopaM samutsRRijya gatamanyurmahAmanAH |
hA hA bhImeti chukrosha bhUyaH shokasamanvitaH
shlokas.22:
taM viditvA gatakrodhaM bhImasenavadhArditam |
vAsudevo varaH pu.nsAmidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.23:
mA shucho dhRRitarAShTra tvaM naiSha bhImastvayA hataH |
AyasI pratimA hyeShA tvayA rAjannipAtitA
shlokas.24:
tvAM krodhavashamApannaM viditvA bharatarShabha |
mayApakRRiShTaH kaunteyo mRRityordaMShTrAntaraM gataH
shlokas.25:
na hi te rAjashArdUla bale tulyo.asti kashchana |
kaH saheta mahAbAho bAhvornigrahaNaM naraH
shlokas.26:
yathAntakamanuprApya jIvankashchinna muchyate |
evaM bAhvantaraM prApya tava jIvenna kashchana
shlokas.27:
tasmAtputreNa yA sA te pratimA kAritAyasI |
bhImasya seyaM kauravya tavaivopahRRitA mayA
shlokas.28:
putrashokAbhisantApAddharmAdapahRRitaM manaH |
tava rAjendra tena tvaM bhImasenaM jighA.nsasi
shlokas.29:
na cha te tatkShamaM rAjanhanyAstvaM yadvRRikodaram |
na hi putrA mahArAja jIveyuste katha~nchana
shlokas.30:
tasmAdyatkRRitamasmAbhirmanyamAnaiH kShamaM prati |
anumanyasva tatsarvaM mA cha shoke manaH kRRithAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tata enamupAtiShTha~nshauchArthaM parichArakAH |
kRRitashauchaM punashchainaM provAcha madhusUdanaH
shlokas.2:
rAjannadhItA vedAste shAstrANi vividhAni cha |
shrutAni cha purANAni rAjadharmAshcha kevalAH
shlokas.3:
evaM vidvAnmahAprAj~na nAkArShIrvachanaM tadA |
pANDavAnadhikA~njAnanbale shaurye cha kaurava
shlokas.4:
rAjA hi yaH sthirapraj~naH svayaM doShAnavekShate |
deshakAlavibhAgaM cha paraM shreyaH sa vindati
shlokas.5:
uchyamAnaM cha yaH shreyo gRRihNIte no hitAhite |
ApadaM samanuprApya sa shochatyanaye sthitaH
shlokas.6:
tato.anyavRRittamAtmAnaM samavekShasva bhArata |
rAja.nstvaM hyavidheyAtmA duryodhanavashe sthitaH
shlokas.7:
AtmAparAdhAdAyastastatkiM bhImaM jighA.nsasi |
tasmAtsa.nyachCha kopaM tvaM svamanusmRRitya duShkRRitam
shlokas.8:
yastu tAM spardhayA kShudraH pA~nchAlImAnayatsabhAm |
sa hato bhImasenena vairaM pratichikIrShatA
shlokas.9:
Atmano.atikramaM pashya putrasya cha durAtmanaH |
yadanAgasi pANDUnAM parityAgaH parantapa
shlokas.10:
evamuktaH sa kRRiShNena sarvaM satyaM janAdhipa |
uvAcha devakIputraM dhRRitarAShTro mahIpatiH
shlokas.11:
evametanmahAbAho yathA vadasi mAdhava |
putrasnehastu dharmAtmandhairyAnmAM samachAlayat
shlokas.12:
diShTyA tu puruShavyAghro balavAnsatyavikramaH |
tvadgupto nAgamatkRRiShNa bhImo bAhvantaraM mama
shlokas.13:
idAnIM tvahamekAgro gatamanyurgatajvaraH |
madhyamaM pANDavaM vIraM spraShTumichChAmi keshava
shlokas.14:
hateShu pArthivendreShu putreShu nihateShu cha |
pANDuputreShu me sharma prItishchApyavatiShThate
shlokas.15:
tataH sa bhImaM cha dhana~njayaM cha; mAdryAshcha putrau puruShapravIrau |
pasparsha gAtraiH prarudansugAtrA;nAshvAsya kalyANamuvAcha chainAn

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dhRRitarAShTrAbhyanuj~nAtAstataste kurupu~NgavAH |
abhyayurbhrAtaraH sarve gAndhArIM sahakeshavAH
shlokas.2:
tato j~nAtvA hatAmitraM dharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram |
gAndhArI putrashokArtA shaptumaichChadaninditA
shlokas.3:
tasyAH pApamabhiprAyaM viditvA pANDavAnprati |
RRiShiH satyavatIputraH prAgeva samabudhyata
shlokas.4:
sa ga~NgAyAmupaspRRishya puNyagandhaM payaH shuchi |
taM deshamupasampede paramarShirmanojavaH
shlokas.5:
divyena chakShuShA pashyanmanasAnuddhatena cha |
sarvaprANabhRRitAM bhAvaM sa tatra samabudhyata
shlokas.6:
sa snuShAmabravItkAle kalyavAdI mahAtapAH |
shApakAlamavAkShipya shamakAlamudIrayan
shlokas.7:
na kopaH pANDave kAryo gAndhAri shamamApnuhi |
rajo nigRRihyatAmetachChRRiNu chedaM vacho mama
shlokas.8:
uktAsyaShTAdashAhAni putreNa jayamichChatA |
shivamAshAssva me mAtaryudhyamAnasya shatrubhiH
shlokas.9:
sA tathA yAchyamAnA tvaM kAle kAle jayaiShiNA |
uktavatyasi gAndhAri yato dharmastato jayaH
shlokas.10:
na chApyatItAM gAndhAri vAchaM te vitathAmaham |
smarAmi bhAShamANAyAstathA praNihitA hyasi
shlokas.11:
sA tvaM dharmaM parismRRitya vAchA choktvA manasvini |
kopaM sa.nyachCha gAndhAri maivaM bhUH satyavAdini
shlokas.12:
gAndhAryuvAcha||
bhagavannAbhyasUyAmi naitAnichChAmi nashyataH |
putrashokena tu balAnmano vihvalatIva me
shlokas.13:
yathaiva kuntyA kaunteyA rakShitavyAstathA mayA |
yathaiva dhRRitarAShTreNa rakShitavyAstathA mayA
shlokas.14:
duryodhanAparAdhena shakuneH saubalasya cha |
karNaduHshAsanAbhyAM cha vRRitto.ayaM kurusa~NkShayaH
shlokas.15:
nAparAdhyati bIbhatsurna cha pArtho vRRikodaraH |
nakulaH sahadevo vA naiva jAtu yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.16:
yudhyamAnA hi kauravyAH kRRintamAnAH parasparam |
nihatAH sahitAshchAnyaistatra nAstyapriyaM mama
shlokas.17:
yattu karmAkarodbhImo vAsudevasya pashyataH |
duryodhanaM samAhUya gadAyuddhe mahAmanAH
shlokas.18:
shikShayAbhyadhikaM j~nAtvA charantaM bahudhA raNe |
adho nAbhyAM prahRRitavA.nstanme kopamavardhayat
shlokas.19:
kathaM nu dharmaM dharmaj~naiH samuddiShTaM mahAtmabhiH |
tyajeyurAhave shUrAH prANahetoH katha~nchana

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tachChrutvA vachanaM tasyA bhImaseno.atha bhItavat |
gAndhArIM pratyuvAchedaM vachaH sAnunayaM tadA
shlokas.2:
adharmo yadi vA dharmastrAsAttatra mayA kRRitaH |
AtmAnaM trAtukAmena tanme tvaM kShantumarhasi
shlokas.3:
na hi yuddhena putraste dharmeNa sa mahAbalaH |
shakyaH kenachidudyantumato viShamamAcharam
shlokas.4:
sainyasyaiko.avashiShTo.ayaM gadAyuddhe cha vIryavAn |
mAM hatvA na haredrAjyamiti chaitatkRRitaM mayA
shlokas.5:
rAjaputrIM cha pA~nchAlImekavastrAM rajasvalAm |
bhavatyA viditaM sarvamuktavAnyatsutastava
shlokas.6:
suyodhanamasa~NgRRihya na shakyA bhUH sasAgarA |
kevalA bhoktumasmAbhiratashchaitatkRRitaM mayA
shlokas.7:
tachchApyapriyamasmAkaM putraste samupAcharat |
draupadyA yatsabhAmadhye savyamUrumadarshayat
shlokas.8:
tatraiva vadhyaH so.asmAkaM durAchAro.amba te sutaH |
dharmarAjAj~nayA chaiva sthitAH sma samaye tadA
shlokas.9:
vairamuddhukShitaM rAj~ni putreNa tava tanmahat |
kleshitAshcha vane nityaM tata etatkRRitaM mayA
shlokas.10:
vairasyAsya gataH pAraM hatvA duryodhanaM raNe |
rAjyaM yudhiShThiraH prApto vayaM cha gatamanyavaH
shlokas.11:
gAndhAryuvAcha||
na tasyaiSha vadhastAta yatprasha.nsasi me sutam |
kRRitavA.nshchApi tatsarvaM yadidaM bhAShase mayi
shlokas.12:
hatAshve nakule yattadvRRiShasenena bhArata |
apibaH shoNitaM sa~Nkhye duHshAsanasharIrajam
shlokas.13:
sadbhirvigarhitaM ghoramanAryajanasevitam |
krUraM karmAkaroH kasmAttadayuktaM vRRikodara
shlokas.14:
bhImasena uvAcha||
anyasyApi na pAtavyaM rudhiraM kiM punaH svakam |
yathaivAtmA tathA bhrAtA visheSho nAsti kashchana
shlokas.15:
rudhiraM na vyatikrAmaddantoShThaM me.amba mA shuchaH |
vaivasvatastu tadveda hastau me rudhirokShitau
shlokas.16:
hatAshvaM nakulaM dRRiShTvA vRRiShasenena sa.nyuge |
bhrAtR^INAM samprahRRiShTAnAM trAsaH sa~njanito mayA
shlokas.17:
keshapakShaparAmarshe draupadyA dyUtakArite |
krodhAdyadabruvaM chAhaM tachcha me hRRidi vartate
shlokas.18:
kShatradharmAchchyuto rAj~ni bhaveyaM shAsvatIH samAH |
pratij~nAM tAmanistIrya tatastatkRRitavAnaham
shlokas.19:
na mAmarhasi gAndhAri doSheNa parisha~Nkitum |
anigRRihya purA putrAnasmAsvanapakAriShu
shlokas.20:
gAndhAryuvAcha||
vRRiddhasyAsya shataM putrAnnighna.nstvamaparAjitaH |
kasmAnna sheShayaH ka~nchidyenAlpamaparAdhitam
shlokas.21:
santAnamAvayostAta vRRiddhayorhRRitarAjyayoH |
kathamandhadvayasyAsya yaShTirekA na varjitA
shlokas.22:
sheShe hyavasthite tAta putrANAmantake tvayi |
na me duHkhaM bhavedetadyadi tvaM dharmamAcharaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA tu gAndhArI yudhiShThiramapRRichChata |
kva sa rAjeti sakrodhA putrapautravadhArditA
shlokas.2:
tAmabhyagachChadrAjendro vepamAnaH kRRitA~njaliH |
yudhiShThira idaM chainAM madhuraM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.3:
putrahantA nRRisha.nso.ahaM tava devi yudhiShThiraH |
shApArhaH pRRithivInAshe hetubhUtaH shapasva mAm
shlokas.4:
na hi me jIvitenArtho na rAjyena dhanena vA |
tAdRRishAnsuhRRido hatvA mUDhasyAsya suhRRiddruhaH
shlokas.5:
tameva.nvAdinaM bhItaM saMnikarShagataM tadA |
novAcha ki~nchidgAndhArI niHshvAsaparamA bhRRisham
shlokas.6:
tasyAvanatadehasya pAdayornipatiShyataH |
yudhiShThirasya nRRipaterdharmaj~nA dharmadarshinI
a~NgulyagrANi dadRRishe devI paTTAntareNa sA
shlokas.7:
tataH sa kunakIbhUto darshanIyanakho nRRipaH |
taM dRRiShTvA chArjuno.agachChadvAsudevasya pRRiShThataH
shlokas.8:
evaM sa~ncheShTamAnA.nstAnitashchetashcha bhArata |
gAndhArI vigatakrodhA sAntvayAmAsa mAtRRivat
shlokas.9:
tayA te samanuj~nAtA mAtaraM vIramAtaram |
abhyagachChanta sahitAH pRRithAM pRRithulavakShasaH
shlokas.10:
chirasya dRRiShTvA putrAnsA putrAdhibhirabhiplutA |
bAShpamAhArayaddevI vastreNAvRRitya vai mukham
shlokas.11:
tato bAShpaM samutsRRijya saha putraistathA pRRithA |
apashyadetA~nshastraughairbahudhA parivikShatAn
shlokas.12:
sA tAnekaikashaH putrAnsa.nspRRishantI punaH punaH |
anvashochanta duHkhArtA draupadIM cha hatAtmajAm
rudatImatha pA~nchAlIM dadarsha patitAM bhuvi
shlokas.13:
draupadyuvAcha||
Arye pautrAH kva te sarve saubhadrasahitA gatAH |
na tvAM te.adyAbhigachChanti chiradRRiShTAM tapasvinIm
kiM nu rAjyena vai kAryaM vihInAyAH sutairmama
shlokas.14:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tAM samAshvAsayAmAsa pRRithA pRRithulalochanA |
utthApya yAj~nasenIM tu rudatIM shokakarshitAm
shlokas.15:
tayaiva sahitA chApi putrairanugatA pRRithA |
abhyagachChata gAndhArImArtAmArtatarA svayam
shlokas.16:
tAmuvAchAtha gAndhArI saha vadhvA yashasvinIm |
maivaM putrIti shokArtA pashya mAmapi duHkhitAm
shlokas.17:
manye lokavinAsho.ayaM kAlaparyAyachoditaH |
avashyabhAvI samprAptaH svabhAvAllomaharShaNaH
shlokas.18:
idaM tatsamanuprAptaM vidurasya vacho mahat |
asiddhAnunaye kRRiShNe yaduvAcha mahAmatiH
shlokas.19:
tasminnaparihArye.arthe vyatIte cha visheShataH |
mA shucho na hi shochyAste sa~NgrAme nidhanaM gatAH
shlokas.20:
yathaiva tvaM tathaivAhaM ko vA mAshvAsayiShyati |
mamaiva hyaparAdhena kulamagryaM vinAshitam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA tu gAndhArI kurUNAmAvikartanam |
apashyattatra tiShThantI sarvaM divyena chakShuShA
shlokas.2:
pativratA mahAbhAgA samAnavratachAriNI |
ugreNa tapasA yuktA satataM satyavAdinI
shlokas.3:
varadAnena kRRiShNasya maharSheH puNyakarmaNaH |
divyaj~nAnabalopetA vividhaM paryadevayat
shlokas.4:
dadarsha sA buddhimatI dUrAdapi yathAntike |
raNAjiraM nRRivIrANAmadbhutaM lomaharShaNam
shlokas.5:
asthikeshaparistIrNaM shoNitaughapariplutam |
sharIrairbahusAhasrairvinikIrNaM samantataH
shlokas.6:
gajAshvarathayodhAnAmAvRRitaM rudhirAvilaiH |
sharIrairashiraskaishcha videhaishcha shirogaNaiH
shlokas.7:
gajAshvanaravIrANAM niHsattvairabhisa.nvRRitam |
sRRigAlabaDakAkolaka~NkakAkaniShevitam
shlokas.8:
rakShasAM puruShAdAnAM modanaM kurarAkulam |
ashivAbhiH shivAbhishcha nAditaM gRRidhrasevitam
shlokas.9:
tato vyAsAbhyanuj~nAto dhRRitarAShTro mahIpatiH |
pANDuputrAshcha te sarve yudhiShThirapurogamAH
shlokas.10:
vAsudevaM puraskRRitya hatabandhuM cha pArthivam |
kurustriyaH samAsAdya jagmurAyodhanaM prati
shlokas.11:
samAsAdya kurukShetraM tAH striyo nihateshvarAH |
apashyanta hatA.nstatra putrAnbhrAtR^InpitR^InpatIn
shlokas.12:
kravyAdairbhakShyamANAnvai gomAyubaDavAyasaiH |
bhUtaiH pishAchai rakShobhirvividhaishcha nishAcharaiH
shlokas.13:
rudrAkrIDanibhaM dRRiShTvA tadA vishasanaM striyaH |
mahArhebhyo.atha yAnebhyo vikroshantyo nipetire
shlokas.14:
adRRiShTapUrvaM pashyantyo duHkhArtA bharatastriyaH |
sharIreShvaskhalannanyA nyapata.nshchAparA bhuvi
shlokas.15:
shrAntAnAM chApyanAthAnAM nAsItkAchana chetanA |
pA~nchAlakuruyoShANAM kRRipaNaM tadabhUnmahat
shlokas.16:
duHkhopahatachittAbhiH samantAdanunAditam |
dRRiShTvAyodhanamatyugraM dharmaj~nA subalAtmajA
shlokas.17:
tataH sA puNDarIkAkShamAmantrya puruShottamam |
kurUNAM vaishasaM dRRiShTvA duHkhAdvachanamabravIt
shlokas.18:
pashyaitAH puNDarIkAkSha snuShA me nihateshvarAH |
prakIrNakeshAH kroshantIH kurarIriva mAdhava
shlokas.19:
amUstvabhisamAgamya smarantyo bharatarShabhAn |
pRRithagevAbhyadhAvanta putrAnbhrAtR^InpitR^InpatIn
shlokas.20:
vIrasUbhirmahAbAho hataputrAbhirAvRRitam |
kvachichcha vIrapatnIbhirhatavIrAbhirAkulam
shlokas.22:
kA~nchanaiH kavachairniShkairmaNibhishcha mahAtmanAm |
a~NgadairhastakeyUraiH sragbhishcha samala~NkRRitam
shlokas.23:
vIrabAhuvisRRiShTAbhiH shaktibhiH parighairapi |
khaDgaishcha vimalaistIkShNaiH sasharaishcha sharAsanaiH
shlokas.24:
kravyAdasa~NghairmuditaistiShThadbhiH sahitaiH kvachit |
kvachidAkrIDamAnaishcha shayAnairaparaiH kvachit
shlokas.25:
etadeva.nvidhaM vIra sampashyAyodhanaM vibho |
pashyamAnA cha dahyAmi shokenAhaM janArdana
shlokas.26:
pA~nchAlAnAM kurUNAM cha vinAshaM madhusUdana |
pa~nchAnAmiva bhUtAnAM nAhaM vadhamachintayam
shlokas.27:
tAnsuparNAshcha gRRidhrAshcha niShkarShantyasRRigukShitAn |
nigRRihya kavacheShUgrA bhakShayanti sahasrashaH
shlokas.28:
jayadrathasya karNasya tathaiva droNabhIShmayoH |
abhimanyorvinAshaM cha kashchintayitumarhati
shlokas.31:
shayanAnyuchitAH sarve mRRidUni vimalAni cha |
vipannAste.adya vasudhAM vivRRitAmadhisherate
shlokas.32:
bandibhiH satataM kAle stuvadbhirabhinanditAH |
shivAnAmashivA ghorAH shRRiNvanti vividhA giraH
shlokas.33:
ye purA sherate vIrAH shayaneShu yashasvinaH |
chandanAgurudigdhA~NgAste.adya pA.nsuShu sherate
shlokas.34:
teShAmAbharaNAnyete gRRidhragomAyuvAyasAH |
AkShipantyashivA ghorA vinadantaH punaH punaH
shlokas.35:
chApAni vishikhAnpItAnnistri.nshAnvimalA gadAH |
yuddhAbhimAninaH prItA jIvanta iva bibhrati
shlokas.36:
surUpavarNA bahavaH kravyAdairavaghaTTitAH |
RRiShabhapratirUpAkShAH sherate haritasrajaH
shlokas.37:
apare punarAli~Ngya gadAH parighabAhavaH |
sherate.abhimukhAH shUrA dayitA iva yoShitaH
shlokas.38:
bibhrataH kavachAnyanye vimalAnyAyudhAni cha |
na dharShayanti kravyAdA jIvantIti janArdana
shlokas.39:
kravyAdaiH kRRiShyamANAnAmapareShAM mahAtmanAm |
shAtakaumbhyaH srajashchitrA viprakIrNAH samantataH
shlokas.40:
ete gomAyavo bhImA nihatAnAM yashasvinAm |
kaNThAntaragatAnhArAnAkShipanti sahasrashaH
shlokas.41:
sarveShvapararAtreShu yAnanandanta bandinaH |
stutibhishcha parArdhyAbhirupachAraishcha shikShitAH
shlokas.42:
tAnimAH paridevanti duHkhArtAH paramA~NganAH |
kRRipaNaM vRRiShNishArdUla duHkhashokArditA bhRRisham
shlokas.43:
raktotpalavanAnIva vibhAnti ruchirANi vai |
mukhAni paramastrINAM parishuShkANi keshava
shlokas.44:
ruditoparatA hyetA dhyAyantyaH sampariplutAH |
kurustriyo.abhigachChanti tena tenaiva duHkhitAH
shlokas.45:
etAnyAdityavarNAni tapanIyanibhAni cha |
roSharodanatAmrANi vaktrANi kuruyoShitAm
shlokas.46:
AsAmaparipUrNArthaM nishamya paridevitam |
itaretarasa~NkrandAnna vijAnanti yoShitaH
shlokas.47:
etA dIrghamivochChvasya vikrushya cha vilapya cha |
vispandamAnA duHkhena vIrA jahati jIvitam
shlokas.48:
bahvyo dRRiShTvA sharIrANi kroshanti vilapanti cha |
pANibhishchAparA ghnanti shirA.nsi mRRidupANayaH
shlokas.49:
shirobhiH patitairhastaiH sarvA~NgairyUthashaH kRRitaiH |
itaretarasampRRiktairAkIrNA bhAti medinI
shlokas.50:
vishiraskAnatho kAyAndRRiShTvA ghorAbhinandinaH |
muhyantyanuchitA nAryo videhAni shirA.nsi cha
shlokas.51:
shiraH kAyena sandhAya prekShamANA vichetasaH |
apashyantyo paraM tatra nedamasyeti duHkhitAH
shlokas.54:
pANibhishchAparA ghnanti shirA.nsi madhusUdana |
prekShya bhrAtR^InpitR^InputrAnpatI.nshcha nihatAnparaiH
shlokas.55:
bAhubhishcha sakhaDgaishcha shirobhishcha sakuNDalaiH |
agamyakalpA pRRithivI mA.nsashoNitakardamA
shlokas.56:
na duHkheShUchitAH pUrvaM duHkhaM gAhantyaninditAH |
bhrAtRRibhiH pitRRibhiH putrairupakIrNAM vasundharAm
shlokas.57:
yUthAnIva kishorINAM sukeshInAM janArdana |
snuShANAM dhRRitarAShTrasya pashya vRRindAnyanekashaH
shlokas.58:
ato duHkhataraM kiM nu keshava pratibhAti me |
yadimAH kurvate sarvA rUpamuchchAvachaM striyaH
shlokas.59:
nUnamAcharitaM pApaM mayA pUrveShu janmasu |
yA pashyAmi hatAnputrAnpautrAnbhrAtR^I.nshcha keshava
evamArtA vilapatI dadarsha nihataM sutam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato duryodhanaM dRRiShTvA gAndhArI shokakarshitA |
sahasA nyapatadbhUmau Chinneva kadalI vane
shlokas.2:
sA tu labdhvA punaH sa~nj~nAM vikrushya cha punaH punaH |
duryodhanamabhiprekShya shayAnaM rudhirokShitam
shlokas.3:
pariShvajya cha gAndhArI kRRipaNaM paryadevayat |
hA hA putreti shokArtA vilalApAkulendriyA
shlokas.4:
sugUDhajatru vipulaM hAraniShkaniShevitam |
vAriNA netrajenoraH si~nchantI shokatApitA
samIpasthaM hRRiShIkeshamidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.5:
upasthite.asminsa~NgrAme j~nAtInAM sa~NkShaye vibho |
mAmayaM prAha vArShNeya prA~njalirnRRipasattamaH
asmi~nj~nAtisamuddharShe jayamambA bravItu me
shlokas.6:
ityukte jAnatI sarvamahaM svaM vyasanAgamam |
abruvaM puruShavyAghra yato dharmastato jayaH
shlokas.7:
yathA na yudhyamAnastvaM sampramuhyasi putraka |
dhruvaM shastrajitA.NllokAnprAptAsyamaravadvibho
shlokas.8:
ityevamabruvaM pUrvaM nainaM shochAmi vai prabho |
dhRRitarAShTraM tu shochAmi kRRipaNaM hatabAndhavam
shlokas.9:
amarShaNaM yudhAM shreShThaM kRRitAstraM yuddhadurmadam |
shayAnaM vIrashayane pashya mAdhava me sutam
shlokas.10:
yo.ayaM mUrdhAvasiktAnAmagre yAti parantapaH |
so.ayaM pA.nsuShu shete.adya pashya kAlasya paryayam
shlokas.11:
dhruvaM duryodhano vIro gatiM nasulabhAM gataH |
tathA hyabhimukhaH shete shayane vIrasevite
shlokas.12:
yaM purA paryupAsInA ramayanti mahIkShitaH |
mahItalasthaM nihataM gRRidhrAstaM paryupAsate
shlokas.13:
yaM purA vyajanairagryairupavIjanti yoShitaH |
tamadya pakShavyajanairupavIjanti pakShiNaH
shlokas.14:
eSha shete mahAbAhurbalavAnsatyavikramaH |
siMheneva dvipaH sa~Nkhye bhImasenena pAtitaH
shlokas.15:
pashya duryodhanaM kRRiShNa shayAnaM rudhirokShitam |
nihataM bhImasenena gadAmudyamya bhArata
shlokas.16:
akShauhiNIrmahAbAhurdasha chaikAM cha keshava |
anayadyaH purA sa~Nkhye so.anayAnnidhanaM gataH
shlokas.17:
eSha duryodhanaH shete maheShvAso mahArathaH |
shArdUla iva siMhena bhImasenena pAtitaH
shlokas.18:
viduraM hyavamanyaiSha pitaraM chaiva mandabhAk |
bAlo vRRiddhAvamAnena mando mRRityuvashaM gataH
shlokas.19:
niHsapatnA mahI yasya trayodasha samAH sthitA |
sa shete nihato bhUmau putro me pRRithivIpatiH
shlokas.20:
apashyaM kRRiShNa pRRithivIM dhArtarAShTrAnushAsanAt |
pUrNAM hastigavAshvasya vArShNeya na tu tachchiram
shlokas.21:
tAmevAdya mahAbAho pashyAmyanyAnushAsanAt |
hInAM hastigavAshvena kiM nu jIvAmi mAdhava
shlokas.22:
idaM kRRichChrataraM pashya putrasyApi vadhAnmama |
yadimAH paryupAsante hatA~nshUrAnraNe striyaH
shlokas.23:
prakIrNakeshAM sushroNIM duryodhanabhujA~NkagAm |
rukmavedInibhAM pashya kRRiShNa lakShmaNamAtaram
shlokas.24:
nUnameShA purA bAlA jIvamAne mahAbhuje |
bhujAvAshritya ramate subhujasya manasvinI
shlokas.25:
kathaM tu shatadhA nedaM hRRidayaM mama dIryate |
pashyantyA nihataM putraM putreNa sahitaM raNe
shlokas.26:
putraM rudhirasa.nsiktamupajighratyaninditA |
duryodhanaM tu vAmorUH pANinA parimArjati
shlokas.27:
kiM nu shochati bhartAraM putraM chaiShA manasvinI |
tathA hyavasthitA bhAti putraM chApyabhivIkShya sA
shlokas.28:
svashiraH pa~nchashAkhAbhyAmabhihatyAyatekShaNA |
patatyurasi vIrasya kururAjasya mAdhava
shlokas.29:
puNDarIkanibhA bhAti puNDarIkAntaraprabhA |
mukhaM vimRRijya putrasya bhartushchaiva tapasvinI
shlokas.30:
yadi chApyAgamAH santi yadi vA shrutayastathA |
dhruvaM lokAnavApto.ayaM nRRipo bAhubalArjitAn

shlokas.1:
gAndhAryuvAcha||
pashya mAdhava putrAnme shatasa~NkhyA~njitaklamAn |
gadayA bhImasenena bhUyiShThaM nihatAnraNe
shlokas.2:
idaM duHkhataraM me.adya yadimA muktamUrdhajAH |
hataputrA raNe bAlAH paridhAvanti me snuShAH
shlokas.3:
prAsAdatalachAriNyashcharaNairbhUShaNAnvitaiH |
ApannA yatspRRishantImA rudhirArdrAM vasundharAm
shlokas.4:
gRRidhrAnutsArayantyashcha gomAyUnvAyasA.nstathA |
shokenArtA vighUrNantyo mattA iva charantyuta
shlokas.5:
eShAnyA tvanavadyA~NgI karasaMmitamadhyamA |
ghoraM tadvaishasaM dRRiShTvA nipatatyatiduHkhitA
shlokas.6:
dRRiShTvA me pArthivasutAmetAM lakShmaNamAtaram |
rAjaputrIM mahAbAho mano na vyupashAmyati
shlokas.7:
bhrAtR^I.nshchAnyAH patI.nshchAnyAH putrA.nshcha nihatAnbhuvi |
dRRiShTvA paripatantyetAH pragRRihya subhujA bhujAn
shlokas.8:
madhyamAnAM tu nArINAM vRRiddhAnAM chAparAjita |
AkrandaM hatabandhUnAM dAruNe vaishase shRRiNu
shlokas.9:
rathanIDAni dehA.nshcha hatAnAM gajavAjinAm |
AshritAH shramamohArtAH sthitAH pashya mahAbala
shlokas.10:
anyA chApahRRitaM kAyAchchArukuNDalamunnasam |
svasya bandhoH shiraH kRRiShNa gRRihItvA pashya tiShThati
shlokas.11:
pUrvajAtikRRitaM pApaM manye nAlpamivAnagha |
etAbhiranavadyAbhirmayA chaivAlpamedhayA
shlokas.12:
tadidaM dharmarAjena yAtitaM no janArdana |
na hi nAsho.asti vArShNeya karmaNoH shubhapApayoH
shlokas.13:
pratyagravayasaH pashya darshanIyakuchodarAH |
kuleShu jAtA hrImatyaH kRRiShNapakShAkShimUrdhajAH
shlokas.14:
ha.nsagadgadabhAShiNyo duHkhashokapramohitAH |
sArasya iva vAshantyaH patitAH pashya mAdhava
shlokas.15:
phullapadmaprakAshAni puNDarIkAkSha yoShitAm |
anavadyAni vaktrANi tapatyasukharashmivAn
shlokas.16:
IrShUNAM mama putrANAM vAsudevAvarodhanam |
mattamAta~NgadarpANAM pashyantyadya pRRithagjanAH
shlokas.17:
shatachandrANi charmANi dhvajA.nshchAdityasaMnibhAn |
raukmANi chaiva varmANi niShkAnapi cha kA~nchanAn
shlokas.18:
shIrShatrANAni chaitAni putrANAM me mahItale |
pashya dIptAni govinda pAvakAnsuhutAniva
shlokas.19:
eSha duHshAsanaH shete shUreNAmitraghAtinA |
pItashoNitasarvA~Ngo bhImasenena pAtitaH
shlokas.20:
gadayA vIraghAtinyA pashya mAdhava me sutam |
dyUtakleshAnanusmRRitya draupadyA choditena cha
shlokas.21:
uktA hyanena pA~nchAlI sabhAyAM dyUtanirjitA |
priyaM chikIrShatA bhrAtuH karNasya cha janArdana
shlokas.22:
sahaiva sahadevena nakulenArjunena cha |
dAsabhAryAsi pA~nchAli kShipraM pravisha no gRRihAn
shlokas.23:
tato.ahamabruvaM kRRiShNa tadA duryodhanaM nRRipam |
mRRityupAshaparikShiptaM shakuniM putra varjaya
shlokas.24:
nibodhainaM sudurbuddhiM mAtulaM kalahapriyam |
kShipramenaM parityajya putra shAmyasva pANDavaiH
shlokas.25:
na budhyase tvaM durbuddhe bhImasenamamarShaNam |
vA~NnArAchaistuda.nstIkShNairulkAbhiriva ku~njaram
shlokas.26:
tAneSha rabhasaH krUro vAkShalyAnavadhArayan |
utsasarja viShaM teShu sarpo govRRiShabheShviva
shlokas.27:
eSha duHshAsanaH shete vikShipya vipulau bhujau |
nihato bhImasenena siMheneva maharShabhaH

shlokas.1:
gAndhAryuvAcha||
eSha mAdhava putro me vikarNaH prAj~nasaMmataH |
bhUmau vinihataH shete bhImena shatadhA kRRitaH
shlokas.2:
gajamadhyagataH shete vikarNo madhusUdana |
nIlameghaparikShiptaH sharadIva divAkaraH
shlokas.3:
asya chApagraheNaiSha pANiH kRRitakiNo mahAn |
katha~nchichChidyate gRRidhrairattukAmaistalatravAn
shlokas.4:
asya bhAryAmiShaprepsUngRRidhrAnetA.nstapasvinI |
vArayatyanishaM bAlA na cha shaknoti mAdhava
shlokas.5:
yuvA vRRindArakaH shUro vikarNaH puruSharShabha |
sukhochitaH sukhArhashcha shete pA.nsuShu mAdhava
shlokas.6:
karNinAlIkanArAchairbhinnamarmANamAhave |
adyApi na jahAtyenaM lakShmIrbharatasattamam
shlokas.7:
eSha sa~NgrAmashUreNa pratij~nAM pAlayiShyatA |
durmukho.abhimukhaH shete hato.arigaNahA raNe
shlokas.8:
tasyaitadvadanaM kRRiShNa shvApadairardhabhakShitam |
vibhAtyabhyadhikaM tAta saptamyAmiva chandramAH
shlokas.9:
shUrasya hi raNe kRRiShNa yasyAnanamathedRRisham |
sa kathaM nihato.amitraiH pA.nsUngrasati me sutaH
shlokas.10:
yasyAhavamukhe saumya sthAtA naivopapadyate |
sa kathaM durmukho.amitrairhato vibudhalokajit
shlokas.11:
chitrasenaM hataM bhUmau shayAnaM madhusUdana |
dhArtarAShTramimaM pashya pratimAnaM danuShmatAm
shlokas.12:
taM chitramAlyAbharaNaM yuvatyaH shokakarshitAH |
kravyAdasa~NghaiH sahitA rudantyaH paryupAsate
shlokas.13:
strINAM ruditanirghoShaH shvApadAnAM cha garjitam |
chitrarUpamidaM kRRiShNa vichitraM pratibhAti me
shlokas.14:
yuvA vRRindArako nityaM pravarastrIniShevitaH |
vivi.nshatirasau shete dhvastaH pA.nsuShu mAdhava
shlokas.15:
sharasa~NkRRittavarmANaM vIraM vishasane hatam |
parivAryAsate gRRidhrAH parivi.nshA vivi.nshatim
shlokas.16:
pravishya samare vIraH pANDavAnAmanIkinIm |
Avishya shayane shete punaH satpuruShochitam
shlokas.17:
smitopapannaM sunasaM subhru tArAdhipopamam |
atIva shubhraM vadanaM pashya kRRiShNa vivi.nshateH
shlokas.18:
yaM sma taM paryupAsante vasuM vAsavayoShitaH |
krIDantamiva gandharvaM devakanyAH sahasrashaH
shlokas.19:
hantAraM vIrasenAnAM shUraM samitishobhanam |
nibarhaNamamitrANAM duHsahaM viShaheta kaH
shlokas.20:
duHsahasyaitadAbhAti sharIraM sa.nvRRitaM sharaiH |
girirAtmaruhaiH phullaiH karNikArairivAvRRitaH
shlokas.21:
shAtakaumbhyA srajA bhAti kavachena cha bhAsvatA |
agnineva giriH shveto gatAsurapi duHsahaH

shlokas.1:
gAndhAryuvAcha||
adhyardhaguNamAhuryaM bale shaurye cha mAdhava |
pitrA tvayA cha dAshArha dRRiptaM siMhamivotkaTam
shlokas.2:
yo bibheda chamUmeko mama putrasya durbhidAm |
sa bhUtvA mRRityuranyeShAM svayaM mRRityuvashaM gataH
shlokas.3:
tasyopalakShaye kRRiShNa kArShNeramitatejasaH |
abhimanyorhatasyApi prabhA naivopashAmyati
shlokas.4:
eShA virATaduhitA snuShA gANDIvadhanvanaH |
ArtA bAlA patiM vIraM shochyA shochatyaninditA
shlokas.5:
tameShA hi samAsAdya bhAryA bhartAramantike |
virATaduhitA kRRiShNa pANinA parimArjati
shlokas.6:
tasya vaktramupAghrAya saubhadrasya yashasvinI |
vibuddhakamalAkAraM kambuvRRittashirodharam
shlokas.7:
kAmyarUpavatI chaiShA pariShvajati bhAminI |
lajjamAnA purevainaM mAdhvIkamadamUrChitA
shlokas.8:
tasya kShatajasa.ndigdhaM jAtarUpapariShkRRitam |
vimuchya kavachaM kRRiShNa sharIramabhivIkShate
shlokas.9:
avekShamANA taM bAlA kRRiShNa tvAmabhibhAShate |
ayaM te puNDarIkAkSha sadRRishAkSho nipAtitaH
shlokas.10:
bale vIrye cha sadRRishastejasA chaiva te.anagha |
rUpeNa cha tavAtyarthaM shete bhuvi nipAtitaH
shlokas.11:
atyantasukumArasya rA~NkavAjinashAyinaH |
kachchidadya sharIraM te bhUmau na paritapyate
shlokas.12:
mAta~NgabhujavarShmANau jyAkShepakaThinatvachau |
kA~nchanA~Ngadinau sheShe nikShipya vipulau bhujau
shlokas.13:
vyAyamya bahudhA nUnaM sukhasuptaH shramAdiva |
evaM vilapatImArtAM na hi mAmabhibhAShase
shlokas.14:
AryAmArya subhadrAM tvamimA.nshcha tridashopamAn |
pitR^InmAM chaiva duHkhArtAM vihAya kva gamiShyasi
shlokas.15:
tasya shoNitasa.ndigdhAnkeshAnunnAmya pANinA |
utsa~Nge vaktramAdhAya jIvantamiva pRRichChati
svasrIyaM vAsudevasya putraM gANDIvadhanvanaH
shlokas.16:
kathaM tvAM raNamadhyasthaM jaghnurete mahArathAH |
dhigastu krUrakartR^I.nstAnkRRipakarNajayadrathAn
shlokas.17:
droNadrauNAyanI chobhau yairasi vyasanIkRRitaH |
ratharShabhANAM sarveShAM kathamAsIttadA manaH
shlokas.18:
bAlaM tvAM parivAryaikaM mama duHkhAya jaghnuShAm |
kathaM nu pANDavAnAM cha pA~nchAlAnAM cha pashyatAm
tvaM vIra nidhanaM prApto nAthavAnsannanAthavat
shlokas.19:
dRRiShTvA bahubhirAkrande nihataM tvAmanAthavat |
vIraH puruShashArdUlaH kathaM jIvati pANDavaH
shlokas.20:
na rAjyalAbho vipulaH shatrUNAM vA parAbhavaH |
prItiM dAsyati pArthAnAM tvAmRRite puShkarekShaNa
shlokas.21:
tava shastrajitA.NllokAndharmeNa cha damena cha |
kShipramanvAgamiShyAmi tatra mAM pratipAlaya
shlokas.22:
durmaraM punaraprApte kAle bhavati kenachit |
yadahaM tvAM raNe dRRiShTvA hataM jIvAmi durbhagA
shlokas.23:
kAmidAnIM naravyAghra shlakShNayA smitayA girA |
pitRRiloke sametyAnyAM mAmivAmantrayiShyasi
shlokas.24:
nUnamapsarasAM svarge manA.nsi pramathiShyasi |
parameNa cha rUpeNa girA cha smitapUrvayA
shlokas.25:
prApya puNyakRRitA.NllokAnapsarobhiH sameyivAn |
saubhadra viharankAle smarethAH sukRRitAni me
shlokas.26:
etAvAniha sa.nvAso vihitaste mayA saha |
ShaNmAsAnsaptame mAsi tvaM vIra nidhanaM gataH
shlokas.28:
uttarAmapakRRiShyainAmArtAmArtatarAH svayam |
virATaM nihataM dRRiShTvA kroshanti vilapanti cha
shlokas.29:
droNAstrasharasa~NkRRittaM shayAnaM rudhirokShitam |
virATaM vitudantyete gRRidhragomAyuvAyasAH
shlokas.30:
vitudyamAnaM vihagairvirATamasitekShaNAH |
na shaknuvanti vivashA nivartayitumAturAH
shlokas.31:
AsAmAtapataptAnAmAyAsena cha yoShitAm |
shrameNa cha vivarNAnAM rUpANAM vigataM vapuH
shlokas.32:
uttaraM chAbhimanyuM cha kAmbojaM cha sudakShiNam |
shishUnetAnhatAnpashya lakShmaNaM cha sudarshanam
Ayodhanashiromadhye shayAnaM pashya mAdhava

shlokas.1:
gAndhAryuvAcha||
eSha vaikartanaH shete maheShvAso mahArathaH |
jvalitAnalavatsa~Nkhye sa.nshAntaH pArthatejasA
shlokas.2:
pashya vaikartanaM karNaM nihatyAtirathAnbahUn |
shoNitaughaparItA~NgaM shayAnaM patitaM bhuvi
shlokas.3:
amarShI dIrgharoShashcha maheShvAso mahArathaH |
raNe vinihataH shete shUro gANDIvadhanvanA
shlokas.4:
yaM sma pANDavasantrAsAnmama putrA mahArathAH |
prAyudhyanta puraskRRitya mAta~NgA iva yUthapam
shlokas.5:
shArdUlamiva siMhena samare savyasAchinA |
mAta~Ngamiva mattena mAta~Ngena nipAtitam
shlokas.6:
sametAH puruShavyAghra nihataM shUramAhave |
prakIrNamUrdhajAH patnyo rudatyaH paryupAsate
shlokas.7:
udvignaH satataM yasmAddharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
trayodasha samA nidrAM chintayannnAdhyagachChata
shlokas.8:
anAdhRRiShyaH parairyuddhe shatrubhirmaghavAniva |
yugAntAgnirivArchiShmAnhimavAniva cha sthiraH
shlokas.9:
sa bhUtvA sharaNaM vIro dhArtarAShTrasya mAdhava |
bhUmau vinihataH shete vAtarugNa iva drumaH
shlokas.10:
pashya karNasya patnIM tvaM vRRiShasenasya mAtaram |
lAlapyamAnAH karuNaM rudatIM patitAM bhuvi
shlokas.11:
AchAryashApo.anugato dhruvaM tvAM; yadagrasachchakramiyaM dharA te |
tataH shareNApahRRitaM shiraste; dhana~njayenAhave shatrumadhye
shlokas.12:
aho dhigeShA patitA visa~nj~nA; samIkShya jAmbUnadabaddhaniShkam |
karNaM mahAbAhumadInasattvaM; suSheNamAtA rudatI bhRRishArtA
shlokas.13:
alpAvasheSho hi kRRito mahAtmA; sharIrabhakShaiH paribhakShayadbhiH |
draShTuM na samprItikaraH shashIva; kRRiShNashya pakShasya chaturdashAhe
shlokas.14:
sAvartamAnA patitA pRRithivyA;mutthAya dInA punareva chaiShA |
karNasya vaktraM parijighramANA; rorUyate putravadhAbhitaptA

shlokas.1:
gAndhAryuvAcha||
AvantyaM bhImasenena bhakShayanti nipAtitam |
gRRidhragomAyavaH shUraM bahubandhumabandhuvat
shlokas.2:
taM pashya kadanaM kRRitvA shatrUNAM madhusUdana |
shayAnaM vIrashayane rudhireNa samukShitam
shlokas.3:
taM sRRigAlAshcha ka~NkAshcha kravyAdAshcha pRRithagvidhAH |
tena tena vikarShanti pashya kAlasya paryayam
shlokas.4:
shayAnaM vIrashayane vIramAkrandasAriNam |
Avantyamabhito nAryo rudatyaH paryupAsate
shlokas.5:
prAtipIyaM maheShvAsaM hataM bhallena bAhlikam |
prasuptamiva shArdUlaM pashya kRRiShNa manasvinam
shlokas.6:
atIva mukhavarNo.asya nihatasyApi shobhate |
somasyevAbhipUrNasya paurNamAsyAM samudyataH
shlokas.7:
putrashokAbhitaptena pratij~nAM parirakShatA |
pAkashAsaninA sa~Nkhye vArddhakShatrirnipAtitaH
shlokas.8:
ekAdasha chamUrjitvA rakShyamANaM mahAtmanA |
satyaM chikIrShatA pashya hatamenaM jayadratham
shlokas.9:
sindhusauvIrabhartAraM darpapUrNaM manasvinam |
bhakShayanti shivA gRRidhrA janArdana jayadratham
shlokas.10:
sa.nrakShyamANaM bhAryAbhiranuraktAbhirachyuta |
bhaShanto vyapakarShanti gahanaM nimnamantikAt
shlokas.11:
tametAH paryupAsante rakShamANA mahAbhujam |
sindhusauvIragAndhArakAmbojayavanastriyaH
shlokas.12:
yadA kRRiShNAmupAdAya prAdravatkekayaiH saha |
tadaiva vadhyaH pANDUnAM janArdana jayadrathaH
shlokas.13:
duHshalAM mAnayadbhistu yadA mukto jayadrathaH |
kathamadya na tAM kRRiShNa mAnayanti sma te punaH
shlokas.14:
saiShA mama sutA bAlA vilapantI suduHkhitA |
pramApayati chAtmAnamAkroshati cha pANDavAn
shlokas.15:
kiM nu duHkhataraM kRRiShNa paraM mama bhaviShyati |
yatsutA vidhavA bAlA snuShAshcha nihateshvarAH
shlokas.16:
aho dhigduHshalAM pashya vItashokabhayAmiva |
shiro bharturanAsAdya dhAvamAnAmitastataH
shlokas.17:
vArayAmAsa yaH sarvAnpANDavAnputragRRiddhinaH |
sa hatvA vipulAH senAH svayaM mRRityuvashaM gataH
shlokas.18:
taM mattamiva mAta~NgaM vIraM paramadurjayam |
parivArya rudantyetAH striyashchandropamAnanAH

shlokas.1:
gAndhAryuvAcha||
eSha shalyo hataH shete sAkShAnnakulamAtulaH |
dharmaj~nena satA tAta dharmarAjena sa.nyuge
shlokas.2:
yastvayA spardhate nityaM sarvatra puruSharShabha |
sa eSha nihataH shete madrarAjo mahArathaH
shlokas.3:
yena sa~NgRRihNatA tAta rathamAdhiratheryudhi |
jayArthaM pANDuputrANAM tathA tejovadhaH kRRitaH
shlokas.4:
aho dhikpashya shalyasya pUrNachandrasudarshanam |
mukhaM padmapalAshAkShaM vaDairAdaShTamavraNam
shlokas.5:
eShA chAmIkarAbhasya taptakA~nchanasaprabhA |
AsyAdviniHsRRitA jihvA bhakShyate kRRiShNa pakShibhiH
shlokas.6:
yudhiShThireNa nihataM shalyaM samitishobhanam |
rudantyaH paryupAsante madrarAjakulastriyaH
shlokas.7:
etAH susUkShmavasanA madrarAjaM nararShabham |
kroshantyabhisamAsAdya kShatriyAH kShatriyarShabham
shlokas.8:
shalyaM nipatitaM nAryaH parivAryAbhitaH sthitAH |
vAshitA gRRiShTayaH pa~Nke parimagnamivarShabham
shlokas.9:
shalyaM sharaNadaM shUraM pashyainaM rathasattamam |
shayAnaM vIrashayane sharairvishakalIkRRitam
shlokas.10:
eSha shailAlayo rAjA bhagadattaH pratApavAn |
gajA~NkushadharaH shreShThaH shete bhuvi nipAtitaH
shlokas.11:
yasya rukmamayI mAlA shirasyeShA virAjate |
shvApadairbhakShyamANasya shobhayantIva mUrdhajAn
shlokas.12:
etena kila pArthasya yuddhamAsItsudAruNam |
lomaharShaNamatyugraM shakrasya balinA yathA
shlokas.13:
yodhayitvA mahAbAhureSha pArthaM dhana~njayam |
sa.nshayaM gamayitvA cha kuntIputreNa pAtitaH
shlokas.14:
yasya nAsti samo loke shaurye vIrye cha kashchana |
sa eSha nihataH shete bhIShmo bhIShmakRRidAhave
shlokas.15:
pashya shAntanavaM kRRiShNa shayAnaM sUryavarchasam |
yugAnta iva kAlena pAtitaM sUryamambarAt
shlokas.16:
eSha taptvA raNe shatrU~nshastratApena vIryavAn |
narasUryo.astamabhyeti sUryo.astamiva keshava
shlokas.17:
sharatalpagataM vIraM dharme devApinA samam |
shayAnaM vIrashayane pashya shUraniShevite
shlokas.18:
karNinAlIkanArAchairAstIrya shayanottamam |
Avishya shete bhagavAnskandaH sharavaNaM yathA
shlokas.19:
atUlapUrNaM gA~NgeyastribhirbANaiH samanvitam |
upadhAyopadhAnAgryaM dattaM gANDIvadhanvanA
shlokas.20:
pAlayAnaH pituH shAstramUrdhvaretA mahAyashAH |
eSha shAntanavaH shete mAdhavApratimo yudhi
shlokas.21:
dharmAtmA tAta dharmaj~naH pAramparyeNa nirNaye |
amartya iva martyaH sanneSha prANAnadhArayat
shlokas.22:
nAsti yuddhe kRRitI kashchinna vidvAnna parAkramI |
yatra shAntanavo bhIShmaH shete.adya nihataH paraiH
shlokas.23:
svayametena shUreNa pRRichChyamAnena pANDavaiH |
dharmaj~nenAhave mRRityurAkhyAtaH satyavAdinA
shlokas.24:
pranaShTaH kuruva.nshashcha punaryena samuddhRRitaH |
sa gataH kurubhiH sArdhaM mahAbuddhiH parAbhavam
shlokas.25:
dharmeShu kuravaH kaM nu pariprakShyanti mAdhava |
gate devavrate svargaM devakalpe nararShabhe
shlokas.26:
arjunasya vinetAramAchAryaM sAtyakestathA |
taM pashya patitaM droNaM kurUNAM gurusattamam
shlokas.27:
astraM chaturvidhaM veda yathaiva tridasheshvaraH |
bhArgavo vA mahAvIryastathA droNo.api mAdhava
shlokas.28:
yasya prasAdAdbIbhatsuH pANDavaH karma duShkaram |
chakAra sa hataH shete nainamastrANyapAlayan
shlokas.29:
yaM purodhAya kurava Ahvayanti sma pANDavAn |
so.ayaM shastrabhRRitAM shreShTho droNaH shastraiH pRRithakkRRitaH
shlokas.30:
yasya nirdahataH senAM gatiragnerivAbhavat |
sa bhUmau nihataH shete shAntArchiriva pAvakaH
shlokas.31:
dhanurmuShTirashIrNashcha hastAvApashcha mAdhava |
droNasya nihatasyApi dRRishyate jIvato yathA
shlokas.32:
vedA yasmAchcha chatvAraH sarvAstrANi cha keshava |
anapetAni vai shUrAdyathaivAdau prajApateH
shlokas.33:
vandanArhAvimau tasya bandibhirvanditau shubhau |
gomAyavo vikarShanti pAdau shiShyashatArchitau
shlokas.34:
droNaM drupadaputreNa nihataM madhusUdana |
kRRipI kRRipaNamanvAste duHkhopahatachetanA
shlokas.35:
tAM pashya rudatImArtAM muktakeshImadhomukhIm |
hataM patimupAsantIM droNaM shastrabhRRitAM varam
shlokas.36:
bANairbhinnatanutrANaM dhRRiShTadyumnena keshava |
upAste vai mRRidhe droNaM jaTilA brahmachAriNI
shlokas.37:
pretakRRitye cha yatate kRRipI kRRipaNamAturA |
hatasya samare bhartuH sukumArI yashasvinI
shlokas.38:
agnInAhRRitya vidhivachchitAM prajvAlya sarvashaH |
droNamAdhAya gAyanti trINi sAmAni sAmagAH
shlokas.39:
kiranti cha chitAmete jaTilA brahmachAriNaH |
dhanurbhiH shaktibhishchaiva rathanIDaishcha mAdhava
shlokas.40:
shastraishcha vividhairanyairdhakShyante bhUritejasam |
ta ete droNamAdhAya sha.nsanti cha rudanti cha
shlokas.41:
sAmabhistribhirantaHsthairanusha.nsanti chApare |
agnAvagnimivAdhAya droNaM hutvA hutAshane
shlokas.42:
gachChantyabhimukhA ga~NgAM droNashiShyA dvijAtayaH |
apasavyAM chitiM kRRitvA puraskRRitya kRRipIM tadA

shlokas.1:
gAndhAryuvAcha||
somadattasutaM pashya yuyudhAnena pAtitam |
vitudyamAnaM vihagairbahubhirmAdhavAntike
shlokas.2:
putrashokAbhisantaptaH somadatto janArdana |
yuyudhAnaM maheShvAsaM garhayanniva dRRishyate
shlokas.3:
asau tu bhUrishravaso mAtA shokapariplutA |
AshvAsayati bhartAraM somadattamaninditA
shlokas.4:
diShTyA nedaM mahArAja dAruNaM bharatakShayam |
kurusa~NkrandanaM ghoraM yugAntamanupashyasi
shlokas.5:
diShTyA yUpadhvajaM vIraM putraM bhUrisahasradam |
anekakratuyajvAnaM nihataM nAdya pashyasi
shlokas.6:
diShTyA snuShANAmAkrande ghoraM vilapitaM bahu |
na shRRiNoShi mahArAja sArasInAmivArNave
shlokas.7:
ekavastrAnusa.nvItAH prakIrNAsitamUrdhajAH |
snuShAste paridhAvanti hatApatyA hateshvarAH
shlokas.8:
shvApadairbhakShyamANaM tvamaho diShTyA na pashyasi |
ChinnabAhuM naravyAghramarjunena nipAtitam
shlokas.9:
shalaM vinihataM sa~Nkhye bhUrishravasameva cha |
snuShAshcha vidhavAH sarvA diShTyA nAdyeha pashyasi
shlokas.10:
diShTyA tatkA~nchanaM ChatraM yUpaketormahAtmanaH |
vinikIrNaM rathopasthe saumadatterna pashyasi
shlokas.11:
amUstu bhUrishravaso bhAryAH sAtyakinA hatam |
parivAryAnushochanti bhartAramasitekShaNAH
shlokas.12:
etA vilapya bahulaM bhartRRishokena karshitAH |
patantyabhimukhA bhUmau kRRipaNaM bata keshava
shlokas.13:
bIbhatsuratibIbhatsaM karmedamakarotkatham |
pramattasya yadachChaitsIdbAhuM shUrasya yajvanaH
shlokas.14:
tataH pApataraM karma kRRitavAnapi sAtyakiH |
yasmAtprAyopaviShTasya prAhArShItsa.nshitAtmanaH
shlokas.15:
eko dvAbhyAM hataH sheShe tvamadharmeNa dhArmikaH |
iti yUpadhvajasyaitAH striyaH kroshanti mAdhava
shlokas.16:
bhAryA yUpadhvajasyaiShA karasaMmitamadhyamA |
kRRitvotsa~Nge bhujaM bhartuH kRRipaNaM paryadevayat
shlokas.17:
ayaM sa rashanotkarShI pInastanavimardanaH |
nAbhyUrujaghanasparshI nIvIvisra.nsanaH karaH
shlokas.18:
vAsudevasya sAMnidhye pArthenAkliShTakarmaNA |
yudhyataH samare.anyena pramattasya nipAtitaH
shlokas.19:
kiM nu vakShyasi sa.nsatsu kathAsu cha janArdana |
arjunasya mahatkarma svayaM vA sa kirITavAn
shlokas.20:
ityevaM garhayitvaiShA tUShNImAste varA~NganA |
tAmetAmanushochanti sapatnyaH svAmiva snuShAm
shlokas.21:
gAndhArarAjaH shakunirbalavAnsatyavikramaH |
nihataH sahadevena bhAgineyena mAtulaH
shlokas.22:
yaH purA hemadaNDAbhyAM vyajanAbhyAM sma vIjyate |
sa eSha pakShibhiH pakShaiH shayAna upavIjyate
shlokas.23:
yaH sma rUpANi kurute shatasho.atha sahasrashaH |
tasya mAyAvino mAyA dagdhAH pANDavatejasA
shlokas.24:
mAyayA nikRRitipraj~no jitavAnyo yudhiShThiram |
sabhAyAM vipulaM rAjyaM sa punarjIvitaM jitaH
shlokas.25:
shakuntAH shakuniM kRRiShNa samantAtparyupAsate |
kitavaM mama putrANAM vinAshAyopashikShitam
shlokas.26:
etenaitanmahadvairaM prasaktaM pANDavaiH saha |
vadhAya mama putrANAmAtmanaH sagaNasya cha
shlokas.27:
yathaiva mama putrANAM lokAH shastrajitAH prabho |
evamasyApi durbuddherlokAH shastreNa vai jitAH
shlokas.28:
kathaM cha nAyaM tatrApi putrAnme bhrAtRRibhiH saha |
virodhayedRRijupraj~nAnanRRijurmadhusUdana

shlokas.1:
gAndhAryuvAcha||
kAmbojaM pashya durdharShaM kAmbojAstaraNochitam |
shayAnamRRiShabhaskandhaM hataM pA.nsushu mAdhava
shlokas.2:
yasya kShatajasa.ndigdhau bAhU chandanarUShitau |
avekShya kRRipaNaM bhAryA vilapatyatiduHkhitA
shlokas.3:
imau tau parighaprakhyau bAhU shubhatalA~NgulI |
yayorvivaramApannAM na ratirmAM purAjahat
shlokas.4:
kAM gatiM nu gamiShyAmi tvayA hInA janeshvara |
dUrabandhuranAtheva atIva madhurasvarA
shlokas.5:
Atape klAmyamAnAnAM vividhAnAmiva srajAm |
klAntAnAmapi nArINAM na shrIrjahati vai tanum
shlokas.6:
shayAnamabhitaH shUraM kAli~NgaM madhusUdana |
pashya dIptA~NgadayugapratibaddhamahAbhujam
shlokas.7:
mAgadhAnAmadhipatiM jayatsenaM janArdana |
parivArya praruditA mAgadhyaH pashya yoShitaH
shlokas.8:
AsAmAyatanetrANAM susvarANAM janArdana |
manaHshrutiharo nAdo mano mohayatIva me
shlokas.9:
prakIrNasarvAbharaNA rudantyaH shokakarshitAH |
svAstIrNashayanopetA mAgadhyaH sherate bhuvi
shlokas.10:
kosalAnAmadhipatiM rAjaputraM bRRihadbalam |
bhartAraM parivAryaitAH pRRithakpraruditAH striyaH
shlokas.11:
asya gAtragatAnbANAnkArShNibAhubalArpitAn |
uddharantyasukhAviShTA mUrChamAnAH punaH punaH
shlokas.12:
AsAM sarvAnavadyAnAmAtapena parishramAt |
pramlAnanalinAbhAni bhAnti vaktrANi mAdhava
shlokas.13:
droNena nihatAH shUrAH sherate ruchirA~NgadAH |
droNenAbhimukhAH sarve bhrAtaraH pa~ncha kekayAH
shlokas.14:
taptakA~nchanavarmANastAmradhvajarathasrajaH |
bhAsayanti mahIM bhAsA jvalitA iva pAvakAH
shlokas.15:
droNena drupadaM sa~Nkhye pashya mAdhava pAtitam |
mahAdvipamivAraNye siMhena mahatA hatam
shlokas.16:
pA~nchAlarAj~no vipulaM puNDarIkAkSha pANDuram |
AtapatraM samAbhAti sharadIva divAkaraH
shlokas.17:
etAstu drupadaM vRRiddhaM snuShA bhAryAshcha duHkhitAH |
dagdhvA gachChanti pA~nchAlyaM rAjAnamapasavyataH
shlokas.18:
dhRRiShTaketuM maheShvAsaM chedipu~Ngavama~NganAH |
droNena nihataM shUraM haranti hRRitachetasaH
shlokas.19:
droNAstramabhihatyaiSha vimarde madhusUdana |
maheShvAso hataH shete nadyA hRRita iva drumaH
shlokas.20:
eSha chedipatiH shUro dhRRiShTaketurmahArathaH |
shete vinihataH sa~Nkhye hatvA shatrUnsahasrashaH
shlokas.21:
vitudyamAnaM vihagaistaM bhAryAH pratyupasthitAH |
chedirAjaM hRRiShIkesha hataM sabalabAndhavam
shlokas.22:
dAshArhIputrajaM vIraM shayAnaM satyavikramam |
AropyA~Nke rudantyetAshchedirAjavarA~NganAH
shlokas.23:
asya putraM hRRiShIkesha suvaktraM chArukuNDalam |
droNena samare pashya nikRRittaM bahudhA sharaiH
shlokas.24:
pitaraM nUnamAjisthaM yudhyamAnaM paraiH saha |
nAjahAtpRRiShThato vIramadyApi madhusUdana
shlokas.25:
evaM mamApi putrasya putraH pitaramanvagAt |
duryodhanaM mahAbAho lakShmaNaH paravIrahA
shlokas.26:
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau patitau pashya mAdhava |
himAnte puShpitau shAlau marutA galitAviva
shlokas.28:
avadhyAH pANDavAH kRRiShNa sarva eva tvayA saha |
ye muktA droNabhIShmAbhyAM karNAdvaikartanAtkRRipAt
shlokas.29:
duryodhanAddroNasutAtsaindhavAchcha mahArathAt |
somadattAdvikarNAchcha shUrAchcha kRRitavarmaNaH
ye hanyuH shastravegena devAnapi nararShabhAH
shlokas.30:
ta ime nihatAH sa~Nkhye pashya kAlasya paryayam |
nAtibhAro.asti daivasya dhruvaM mAdhava kashchana
yadime nihatAH shUrAH kShatriyaiH kShatriyarShabhAH
shlokas.31:
tadaiva nihatAH kRRiShNa mama putrAstarasvinaH |
yadaivAkRRitakAmastvamupaplavyaM gataH punaH
shlokas.32:
shantanoshchaiva putreNa prAj~nena vidureNa cha |
tadaivoktAsmi mA snehaM kuruShvAtmasuteShviti
shlokas.33:
tayorna darshanaM tAta mithyA bhavitumarhati |
achireNaiva me putrA bhasmIbhUtA janArdana
shlokas.34:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvA nyapatadbhUmau gAndhArI shokakarshitA |
duHkhopahatavij~nAnA dhairyamutsRRijya bhArata
shlokas.35:
tataH kopaparItA~NgI putrashokapariplutA |
jagAma shauriM doSheNa gAndhArI vyathitendriyA
shlokas.36:
gAndhAryuvAcha||
pANDavA dhArtarAShTrAshcha drugdhAH kRRiShNa parasparam |
upekShitA vinashyantastvayA kasmAjjanArdana
shlokas.37:
shaktena bahubhRRityena vipule tiShThatA bale |
ubhayatra samarthena shrutavAkyena chaiva ha
shlokas.38:
ichChatopekShito nAshaH kurUNAM madhusUdana |
yasmAttvayA mahAbAho phalaM tasmAdavApnuhi
shlokas.39:
patishushrUShayA yanme tapaH ki~nchidupArjitam |
tena tvAM duravApAtma~nshapsye chakragadAdhara
shlokas.40:
yasmAtparasparaM ghnanto j~nAtayaH kurupANDavAH |
upekShitAste govinda tasmAjj~nAtInvadhiShyasi
shlokas.41:
tvamapyupasthite varShe ShaTtri.nshe madhusUdana |
hataj~nAtirhatAmAtyo hataputro vanecharaH
kutsitenAbhyupAyena nidhanaM samavApsyasi
shlokas.42:
tavApyevaM hatasutA nihataj~nAtibAndhavAH |
striyaH paripatiShyanti yathaitA bharatastriyaH
shlokas.43:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tachChrutvA vachanaM ghoraM vAsudevo mahAmanAH |
uvAcha devIM gAndhArImIShadabhyutsmayanniva
shlokas.44:
saMhartA vRRiShNichakrasya nAnyo madvidyate shubhe |
jAne.ahametadapyevaM chIrNaM charasi kShatriye
shlokas.45:
avadhyAste narairanyairapi vA devadAnavaiH |
parasparakRRitaM nAshamataH prApsyanti yAdavAH
shlokas.46:
ityuktavati dAshArhe pANDavAstrastachetasaH |
babhUvurbhRRishasa.nvignA nirAshAshchApi jIvite

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
uttiShThottiShTha gAndhAri mA cha shoke manaH kRRithAH |
tavaiva hyaparAdhena kuravo nidhanaM gatAH
shlokas.2:
yA tvaM putraM durAtmAnamIrShumatyantamAninam |
duryodhanaM puraskRRitya duShkRRitaM sAdhu manyase
shlokas.3:
niShThuraM vairaparuShaM vRRiddhAnAM shAsanAtigam |
kathamAtmakRRitaM doShaM mayyAdhAtumihechChasi
shlokas.4:
mRRitaM vA yadi vA naShTaM yo.atItamanushochati |
duHkhena labhate duHkhaM dvAvanarthau prapadyate
shlokas.5:
taporthIyaM brAhmaNI dhatta garbhaM; gaurvoDhAraM dhAvitAraM tura~NgI |
shUdrA dAsaM pashupAlaM tu vaishyA; vadhArthIyaM tvadvidhA rAjaputrI
shlokas.6:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tachChrutvA vAsudevasya punaruktaM vacho.apriyam |
tUShNIM babhUva gAndhArI shokavyAkulalochanA
shlokas.7:
dhRRitarAShTrastu rAjarShirnigRRihyAbuddhijaM tamaH |
paryapRRichChata dharmAtmA dharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.8:
jIvatAM parimANaj~naH sainyAnAmasi pANDava |
hatAnAM yadi jAnIShe parimANaM vadasva me
shlokas.9:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
dashAyutAnAmayutaM sahasrANi cha vi.nshatiH |
koTyaH ShaShTishcha ShaTchaiva ye.asminrAjamRRidhe hatAH
shlokas.10:
alakShyANAM tu vIrANAM sahasrANi chaturdasha |
dasha chAnyAni rAjendra shataM ShaShTishcha pa~ncha cha
shlokas.11:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yudhiShThira gatiM kAM te gatAH puruShasattamAH |
AchakShva me mahAbAho sarvaj~no hyasi me mataH
shlokas.12:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yairhutAni sharIrANi hRRiShTaiH paramasa.nyuge |
devarAjasamA.NllokAngatAste satyavikramAH
shlokas.13:
ye tvahRRiShTena manasA martavyamiti bhArata |
yudhyamAnA hatAH sa~Nkhye te gandharvaiH samAgatAH
shlokas.14:
ye tu sa~NgrAmabhUmiShThA yAchamAnAH parA~NmukhAH |
shastreNa nidhanaM prAptA gatAste guhyakAnprati
shlokas.15:
pIDyamAnAH parairye tu hIyamAnA nirAyudhAH |
hrIniShedhA mahAtmAnaH parAnabhimukhA raNe
shlokas.16:
ChidyamAnAH shitaiH shastraiH kShatradharmaparAyaNAH |
gatAste brahmasadanaM hatA vIrAH suvarchasaH
shlokas.17:
ye tatra nihatA rAjannantarAyodhanaM prati |
yathA katha~nchitte rAjansamprAptA uttarAnkurUn
shlokas.18:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
kena j~nAnabalenaivaM putra pashyasi siddhavat |
tanme vada mahAbAho shrotavyaM yadi vai mayA
shlokas.19:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
nideshAdbhavataH pUrvaM vane vicharatA mayA |
tIrthayAtrAprasa~Ngena samprApto.ayamanugrahaH
shlokas.20:
devarShirlomasho dRRiShTastataH prApto.asmyanusmRRitim |
divyaM chakShurapi prAptaM j~nAnayogena vai purA
shlokas.21:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
ye.atrAnAthA janasyAsya sanAthA ye cha bhArata |
kachchitteShAM sharIrANi dhakShyanti vidhipUrvakam
shlokas.22:
na yeShAM santi kartAro na cha ye.atrAhitAgnayaH |
vayaM cha kasya kuryAmo bahutvAttAta karmaNaH
shlokas.23:
yAnsuparNAshcha gRRidhrAshcha vikarShanti tatastataH |
teShAM tu karmaNA lokA bhaviShyanti yudhiShThira
shlokas.24:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamukto mahAprAj~naH kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
Adidesha sudharmANaM dhaumyaM sUtaM cha sa~njayam
shlokas.25:
viduraM cha mahAbuddhiM yuyutsuM chaiva kauravam |
indrasenamukhA.nshchaiva bhRRityAnsUtA.nshcha sarvashaH
shlokas.26:
bhavantaH kArayantveShAM pretakAryANi sarvashaH |
yathA chAnAthavatki~nchichCharIraM na vinashyati
shlokas.27:
shAsanAddharmarAjasya kShattA sUtashcha sa~njayaH |
sudharmA dhaumyasahita indrasenAdayastathA
shlokas.28:
chandanAgurukAShThAni tathA kAlIyakAnyuta |
ghRRitaM tailaM cha gandhA.nshcha kShaumANi vasanAni cha
shlokas.29:
samAhRRitya mahArhANi dArUNAM chaiva sa~nchayAn |
rathA.nshcha mRRiditA.nstatra nAnApraharaNAni cha
shlokas.30:
chitAH kRRitvA prayatnena yathAmukhyAnnarAdhipAn |
dAhayAmAsuravyagrA vidhidRRiShTena karmaNA
shlokas.31:
duryodhanaM cha rAjAnaM bhrAtR^I.nshchAsya shatAdhikAn |
shalyaM shalaM cha rAjAnaM bhUrishravasameva cha
shlokas.32:
jayadrathaM cha rAjAnamabhimanyuM cha bhArata |
dauHshAsaniM lakShmaNaM cha dhRRiShTaketuM cha pArthivam
shlokas.33:
bRRihantaM somadattaM cha sRRi~njayA.nshcha shatAdhikAn |
rAjAnaM kShemadhanvAnaM virATadrupadau tathA
shlokas.34:
shikhaNDinaM cha pA~nchAlyaM dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha pArShatam |
yudhAmanyuM cha vikrAntamuttamaujasameva cha
shlokas.35:
kausalyaM draupadeyA.nshcha shakuniM chApi saubalam |
achalaM vRRiShakaM chaiva bhagadattaM cha pArthivam
shlokas.36:
karNaM vaikartanaM chaiva sahaputramamarShaNam |
kekayA.nshcha maheShvAsA.nstrigartA.nshcha mahArathAn
shlokas.37:
ghaTotkachaM rAkShasendraM bakabhrAtarameva cha |
alambusaM cha rAjAnaM jalasandhaM cha pArthivam
shlokas.38:
anyA.nshcha pArthivAnrAja~nshatasho.atha sahasrashaH |
ghRRitadhArAhutairdIptaiH pAvakaiH samadAhayan
shlokas.39:
pitRRimedhAshcha keShA~nchidavartanta mahAtmanAm |
sAmabhishchApyagAyanta te.anvashochyanta chAparaiH
shlokas.40:
sAmnAmRRichAM cha nAdena strINAM cha ruditasvanaiH |
kashmalaM sarvabhUtAnAM nishAyAM samapadyata
shlokas.41:
te vidhUmAH pradIptAshcha dIpyamAnAshcha pAvakAH |
nabhasIvAnvadRRishyanta grahAstanvabhrasa.nvRRitAH
shlokas.42:
ye chApyanAthAstatrAsannAnAdeshasamAgatAH |
tA.nshcha sarvAnsamAnAyya rAshInkRRitvA sahasrashaH
shlokas.43:
chitvA dArubhiravyagraH prabhUtaiH snehatApitaiH |
dAhayAmAsa viduro dharmarAjasya shAsanAt
shlokas.44:
kArayitvA kriyAsteShAM kururAjo yudhiShThiraH |
dhRRitarAShTraM puraskRRitya ga~NgAmabhimukho.agamat

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
te samAsAdya ga~NgAM tu shivAM puNyajanochitAm |
hradinIM vaprasampannAM mahAnUpAM mahAvanAm
shlokas.2:
bhUShaNAnyuttarIyANi veShTanAnyavamuchya cha |
tataH pitR^INAM pautrANAM bhrAtR^INAM svajanasya cha
shlokas.3:
putrANAmAryakANAM cha patInAM cha kurustriyaH |
udakaM chakrire sarvA rudantyo bhRRishaduHkhitAH
suhRRidAM chApi dharmaj~nAH prachakruH salilakriyAH
shlokas.4:
udake kriyamANe tu vIrANAM vIrapatnibhiH |
sUpatIrthAbhavadga~NgA bhUyo viprasasAra cha
shlokas.5:
tanmahodadhisa~NkAshaM nirAnandamanutsavam |
vIrapatnIbhirAkIrNaM ga~NgAtIramashobhata
shlokas.6:
tataH kuntI mahArAja sahasA shokakarshitA |
rudatI mandayA vAchA putrAnvachanamabravIt
shlokas.7:
yaH sa shUro maheShvAso rathayUthapayUthapaH |
arjunena hataH sa~Nkhye vIralakShaNalakShitaH
shlokas.8:
yaM sUtaputraM manyadhvaM rAdheyamiti pANDavAH |
yo vyarAjachchamUmadhye divAkara iva prabhuH
shlokas.9:
pratyayudhyata yaH sarvAnpurA vaH sapadAnugAn |
duryodhanabalaM sarvaM yaH prakarShanvyarochata
shlokas.10:
yasya nAsti samo vIrye pRRithivyAmapi kashchana |
satyasandhasya shUrasya sa~NgrAmeShvapalAyinaH
shlokas.11:
kurudhvamudakaM tasya bhrAturakliShTakarmaNaH |
sa hi vaH pUrvajo bhrAtA bhAskarAnmayyajAyata
kuNDalI kavachI shUro divAkarasamaprabhaH
shlokas.12:
shrutvA tu pANDavAH sarve mAturvachanamapriyam |
karNamevAnushochanta bhUyashchArtatarAbhavan
shlokas.13:
tataH sa puruShavyAghraH kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
uvAcha mAtaraM vIro niHshvasanniva pannagaH
shlokas.14:
yasyeShupAtamAsAdya nAnyastiShTheddhana~njayAt |
kathaM putro bhavatyAM sa devagarbhaH purAbhavat
shlokas.15:
yasya bAhupratApena tApitAH sarvato vayam |
tamagnimiva vastreNa kathaM ChAditavatyasi
yasya bAhubalaM ghoraM dhArtarAShTrairupAsitam
shlokas.16:
nAnyaH kuntIsutAtkarNAdagRRihNAdrathinAM rathI |
sa naH prathamajo bhrAtA sarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH
asUta taM bhavatyagre kathamadbhutavikramam
shlokas.17:
aho bhavatyA mantrasya pidhAnena vayaM hatAH |
nidhanena hi karNasya pIDitAH sma sabAndhavAH
shlokas.18:
abhimanyorvinAshena draupadeyavadhena cha |
pA~nchAlAnAM cha nAshena kurUNAM patanena cha
shlokas.19:
tataH shataguNaM duHkhamidaM mAmaspRRishadbhRRisham |
karNamevAnushochanhi dahyAmyagnAvivAhitaH
shlokas.20:
na hi sma ki~nchidaprApyaM bhavedapi divi sthitam |
na cha sma vaishasaM ghoraM kauravAntakaraM bhavet
shlokas.21:
evaM vilapya bahulaM dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
vinada~nshanakai rAja.nshchakArAsyodakaM prabhuH
shlokas.22:
tato vineduH sahasA strIpu.nsAstatra sarvashaH |
abhito ye sthitAstatra tasminnudakakarmaNi
shlokas.23:
tata AnAyayAmAsa karNasya saparichChadam |
striyaH kurupatirdhImAnbhrAtuH premNA yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.24:
sa tAbhiH saha dharmAtmA pretakRRityamanantaram |
kRRitvottatAra ga~NgAyAH salilAdAkulendriyaH
